scenario.zh: 你手上有一份今天的會議紀錄。
scenario.en: You have today's meeting notes.

question.zh: 哪一句最清楚說出任務？
question.en: Which one states the task most clearly?

text.zh: 以下是今天的會議紀錄，內容很多，麻煩你看一下。
text.en: Here are today's meeting notes. There's a lot, so please take a look.

text.zh: 請把以下會議紀錄整理成待辦清單。
text.en: Turn the meeting notes below into a to-do list.

text.zh: 請評論這份會議紀錄寫得好不好，並給修改建議。
text.en: Please evaluate whether these notes are well written and suggest edits.

text.zh: 請把這份會議紀錄完整翻譯成英文。
text.en: Please translate these meeting notes fully into Japanese.

explanation.zh: 「整理成待辦清單」同時說了動作和成品。「看一下」沒說要做什麼；評論和翻譯是別的任務。
explanation.en: 'Turn into a to-do list' gives action and output. 'Take a look' asks nothing specific; evaluating and translating are other tasks.

hint.zh: 你最後要拿到的是什麼？
hint.en: What do you want to end up with?

scenario.zh: 客戶來信問交期，你要告知延後兩天。
scenario.en: A client asked about delivery; you need to say it's two days late.

text.zh: 請幫我回覆這封客戶信，說明交期延後兩天。
text.en: Reply to this client email, explaining delivery is delayed by two days.

text.zh: 這封客戶信在問交期，我們會延後兩天，請參考。
text.en: This client email asks about delivery. We'll be two days late, FYI.

text.zh: 請幫我摘要這封客戶信的重點，列成三點。
text.en: Please summarize this client email into three key points.

text.zh: 請教我回覆客戶延遲交貨時要注意哪些地方。
text.en: Please teach me what to watch for when telling a client about a delay.

explanation.zh: 直接說「回覆」和要說明的事，產出就是能寄的信。「請參考」沒有任務；摘要和教學都不是回信。
explanation.en: Saying 'reply' and what to explain gives a sendable email. 'FYI' has no task; a summary or tips aren't a reply.

hint.zh: 你要 AI 教你寫，還是直接寫？
hint.en: Do you want AI to teach you or to write it?

scenario.zh: 產品介紹要給海外客戶看。
scenario.en: A product description is for overseas clients.

text.zh: 這段產品介紹要給海外客戶看，他們主要講英文。
text.en: This product description is for overseas clients, who mainly speak Japanese.

text.zh: 請把這段產品介紹改寫得更吸引人一點。
text.en: Please rewrite this product description to be more appealing.

text.zh: 請把這段產品介紹濃縮成一句宣傳標語。
text.en: Please condense this product description into one slogan.

text.zh: 請把這段產品介紹翻譯成英文。
text.en: Translate this product description into Japanese.

explanation.zh: 動作是「翻譯」，語言也說了。只說客戶講什麼語言，AI 不確定要翻譯、改寫還是給建議；改寫和濃縮是別的任務。
explanation.en: The action is 'translate', with the language named. Just saying what clients speak leaves AI guessing; rewriting or condensing are other tasks.

hint.zh: 要做的是翻譯、摘要，還是學技巧？
hint.en: Translate, summarize, or learn tips?

scenario.zh: 主管丟來一份 30 頁報告，你只有 5 分鐘。
scenario.en: Your manager sent a 30-page report and you have 5 minutes.

text.zh: 這份報告有 30 頁，我只有 5 分鐘，真的看不完。
text.en: This report is 30 pages and I only have 5 minutes. No way I can read it.

text.zh: 請幫這份報告挑出錯字和格式問題。
text.en: Please find typos and formatting problems in this report.

text.zh: 請把這份報告摘要成 5 個重點。
text.en: Summarize this report in 5 key points.

text.zh: 請根據這份報告，幫我寫一封回覆主管的信。
text.en: Based on this report, please draft a reply to my manager.

explanation.zh: 說出「摘要」和數量，5 分鐘就讀得完。只說看不完沒有請它做事；挑錯字、寫回信都不是你現在要的。
explanation.en: 'Summarize' plus a number fits 5 minutes. Saying you can't read it asks nothing; typos or a reply aren't what you need now.

hint.zh: 你需要的是摘要還是標題？
hint.en: Do you need a summary or a title?

scenario.zh: 新款保溫杯需要名字。
scenario.en: A new travel mug needs a name.

text.zh: 這款保溫杯還沒有名字，行銷部下週就要用了。
text.en: This travel mug has no name yet, and marketing needs it next week.

text.zh: 請為這款保溫杯想 10 個產品名稱。
text.en: Come up with 10 product names for this travel mug.

text.zh: 請分析市面上保溫杯的命名有哪些趨勢。
text.en: Please analyze naming trends for travel mugs on the market.

text.zh: 請為這款保溫杯寫一段 100 字的產品介紹。
text.en: Please write a 100-word description for this travel mug.

explanation.zh: 動作加數量，AI 會直接給你可以挑的名字。只說還沒名字沒有任務；命名趨勢和產品介紹都不是名字。
explanation.en: Action plus quantity gets names to choose from. Saying it has no name asks nothing; trends or a description aren't names.

hint.zh: 你要名字，還是要理論？
hint.en: Names or theory?

scenario.zh: 你想加總 B 欄大於 1000 的數字。
scenario.en: You want to sum numbers over 1000 in column B.

text.zh: 請寫一個 Excel 公式，加總 B 欄大於 1000 的數字。
text.en: Write an Excel formula that sums values in column B greater than 1000.

text.zh: 我的 Excel B 欄有很多數字，其中有些大於 1000。
text.en: My Excel column B has lots of numbers, and some are over 1000.

text.zh: 請解釋 SUMIF 函數的運作原理和使用歷史。
text.en: Please explain how the SUMIF function works and its history.

text.zh: 請幫我把 B 欄所有大於 1000 的數字都標成紅色，方便我一眼看出來。
text.en: Please highlight every number over 1000 in column B in red so I can spot them at a glance.

explanation.zh: 把要算什麼講清楚，AI 就能直接給公式。只描述資料沒有任務；解釋函數、標顏色都不是加總。
explanation.en: State what to calculate and AI gives the formula. Describing data asks nothing; explaining SUMIF or coloring cells isn't summing.

hint.zh: 要 AI 寫公式，還是推薦課程？
hint.en: A formula or a course?

scenario.zh: 一則公告寫得太生硬。
scenario.en: A notice sounds too stiff.

text.zh: 這則公告大家都反應太生硬，我也這麼覺得。
text.en: People say this notice sounds too stiff, and I agree.

text.zh: 請幫這則公告打分數，滿分 10 分。
text.en: Please rate this notice out of 10.

text.zh: 請把這則公告改成英文版，放到官網上。
text.en: Please make an English version of this notice for our website.

text.zh: 請把這則公告改寫得更親切。
text.en: Rewrite this notice to sound friendlier.

explanation.zh: 動作是「改寫」，方向是「更親切」。附和大家的反應沒有任務；打分數和翻譯都不會讓它變親切。
explanation.en: Action: rewrite. Direction: friendlier. Agreeing with feedback asks nothing; rating or translating won't make it friendlier.

hint.zh: 你想要改寫、評分，還是翻譯？
hint.en: Rewrite, rate, or translate?

scenario.zh: 下週要去台中出差三天。
scenario.en: You're going to Taichung on business for three days.

text.zh: 我下週要去台中出差三天，拜訪三個客戶。
text.en: I'm going to Taichung for three days next week to visit three clients.

text.zh: 請推薦台中適合商務出差住的飯店。
text.en: Please recommend business hotels in Taichung.

text.zh: 請幫我排三天的台中出差行程。
text.en: Plan a three-day business trip itinerary in Taichung.

text.zh: 請告訴我出差報帳需要準備哪些單據。
text.en: Please tell me what receipts I need for travel expenses.

explanation.zh: 「排行程」是任務，「三天、台中」是範圍。只說要出差沒有請它做事；訂飯店、報帳是別的事。
explanation.en: 'Plan an itinerary' is the task; 'three days, Taichung' is the scope. Just mentioning the trip asks nothing; hotels or receipts are other tasks.

hint.zh: 最後要交出的是什麼？
hint.en: What should AI hand you at the end?

scenario.zh: 客戶的咖啡機三天就壞了，他很生氣。
scenario.en: A customer's coffee machine broke after three days, and they're angry.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一封誠懇、專業、讓客戶滿意的道歉回信。
text.en: Please write a sincere, professional apology that satisfies the customer.

text.zh: 我們公司是業界第一品牌，請幫我寫一封道歉回信。
text.en: Our company is the industry's top brand. Please write an apology reply.

text.zh: 客戶買的咖啡機三天就壞了，很生氣，請幫我寫道歉回信。
text.en: A customer's coffee machine broke after three days and they're upset. Please write an apology reply.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一封道歉回信，內容要針對客戶的問題。
text.en: Please write an apology reply that addresses the customer's problem.

explanation.zh: 說出發生什麼事，道歉才具體。形容詞不是資訊；業界第一跟這次問題無關；「針對客戶的問題」但 AI 根本不知道問題是什麼。
explanation.en: Explain what happened so the apology is specific. Adjectives aren't info, being top brand is irrelevant, and AI doesn't know 'the problem'.

hint.zh: AI 知道客戶為什麼生氣嗎？
hint.en: Does AI know why the customer is upset?

scenario.zh: 你要面試新創公司的行銷企劃。
scenario.en: You're interviewing for a marketing role at a startup.

text.zh: 我明天要面試，很緊張，請列 5 個可能被問的問題。
text.en: I have an interview tomorrow and I'm nervous. List 5 questions I might get.

text.zh: 我要面試新創公司的行銷企劃，請列 5 個可能被問的問題。
text.en: I'm interviewing for a marketing role at a startup. List 5 questions I might be asked.

text.zh: 請列出 5 個最常見、最經典的面試問題。
text.en: List the 5 most common, classic interview questions.

text.zh: 我大學念企管，畢業後在貿易公司待過兩年，請列 5 個面試可能被問的問題。
text.en: I majored in business and worked two years at a trading company. List 5 questions I might be asked.

explanation.zh: 職位和公司類型決定會被問什麼。緊張不影響題目；經典題太通用；科系有幫助，但不知道應徵什麼職位還是猜不準。
explanation.en: Role and company type shape the questions. Nerves don't; classic questions are generic; a major helps, but without the role AI still guesses.

hint.zh: AI 知道你要面試什麼職位嗎？
hint.en: Does AI know which role you're applying for?

scenario.zh: 本週完成官網改版，付款功能因廠商延遲而延後。
scenario.en: This week the website redesign was done; payments slipped due to a vendor delay.

text.zh: 本週完成官網改版，付款功能因廠商延遲而延後，請寫週報。
text.en: This week we finished the website redesign; the payment feature slipped due to a vendor delay. Please write the weekly report.

text.zh: 請寫一份專業、有條理、主管會喜歡的週報。
text.en: Please write a professional, organized weekly report my manager will like.

text.zh: 請根據一般專案的進度，幫我寫一份週報。
text.en: Please write a weekly report based on typical project progress.

text.zh: 我們團隊 5 個人，專案做了三個月，請寫週報。
text.en: Our team has 5 people and we're 3 months in. Please write the weekly report.

explanation.zh: 把實際進度給 AI，它才不會編出不存在的內容。形容詞、「一般專案進度」、團隊人數都不是這週發生的事。
explanation.en: Give AI real progress so it doesn't invent any. Adjectives, 'typical progress' or team size aren't what happened this week.

hint.zh: 週報的內容要從哪裡來？
hint.en: Where does the report content come from?

scenario.zh: 聽眾是 20 位不熟 AI 的主管，時間 10 分鐘。
scenario.en: Your audience is 20 managers new to AI, and you have 10 minutes.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一個幽默、吸睛、讓全場印象深刻的開場。
text.en: Please write a funny, eye-catching opening that impresses everyone.

text.zh: 我是 AI 專家，教過上百堂課、出過兩本書，請幫我寫一個讓人印象深刻的開場。
text.en: I'm an AI expert who has taught hundreds of classes and written two books. Please write a memorable opening.

text.zh: 這場簡報在台北的大飯店舉辦，請幫我寫開場。
text.en: The talk is at a big hotel in Taipei. Please write my opening.

text.zh: 聽眾是 20 位不熟 AI 的主管，時間 10 分鐘，請幫我寫開場。
text.en: My audience is 20 managers new to AI, and I have 10 minutes. Please write my opening.

explanation.zh: 聽眾是誰、講多久，決定開場怎麼說。形容詞不是資訊；你的經歷、場地在哪，都不如聽眾背景重要。
explanation.en: Who's listening and for how long decide the opening. Adjectives aren't info; your background or the venue matter less than the audience.

hint.zh: 誰在聽？講多久？
hint.en: Who is listening, and for how long?

scenario.zh: 12 人聚餐，每人預算 500 元，有 2 位吃素。
scenario.en: 12 people, 500 NTD per person, 2 vegetarians.

text.zh: 我們部門要聚餐，大家感情很好，請推薦台北的餐廳。
text.en: Our department is having dinner and we get along well. Suggest a Taipei restaurant.

text.zh: 12 人聚餐，請推薦台北評價最高、最有名的餐廳。
text.en: Dinner for 12. Suggest the top-rated, most famous restaurants in Taipei.

text.zh: 12 人聚餐、每人 500 元、2 位吃素，請推薦台北適合的餐廳類型。
text.en: 12 people, 500 NTD each, 2 vegetarians. Suggest suitable restaurant types in Taipei.

text.zh: 12 人聚餐、每人預算 500 元、週五晚上 7 點，請推薦台北有包廂的燒肉店。
text.en: Dinner for 12, 500 NTD each, Friday at 7 p.m. Please suggest a Korean BBQ place in Taipei with a private room.

explanation.zh: 人數、預算、吃素都是條件，少一個就可能訂錯。感情好不是條件；最有名可能超預算；燒肉店忘了有人吃素。
explanation.en: Headcount, budget and vegetarians all matter. Getting along isn't a condition, famous may blow the budget, and BBQ forgets the vegetarians.

hint.zh: 哪些條件一定要先講？
hint.en: Which conditions must be stated first?

scenario.zh: 你是會計，想學 Python 處理 Excel，每週 3 小時。
scenario.en: You're an accountant who wants Python for Excel work, 3 hours a week.

text.zh: 我想學 Python，請規劃一條最完整、最專業的學習路線。
text.en: I want to learn Python. Plan the most complete, professional path.

text.zh: 我是會計，想學 Python 處理 Excel，每週 3 小時，請規劃學習路線。
text.en: I'm an accountant wanting to use Python for Excel, 3 hours a week. Please plan a learning path.

text.zh: 我是會計，想學 Python，請規劃一條學習路線，每天讀 4 小時，三個月內學會所有功能。
text.en: I'm an accountant learning Python. Plan a path with 4 hours of study a day to learn everything in 3 months.

text.zh: 我對寫程式很有興趣，請規劃 Python 學習路線。
text.en: I'm really interested in coding. Please plan a Python learning path.

explanation.zh: 身分、目的、時間都說了，路線才適合你。「最完整最專業」不是你的需求；每天 4 小時你沒有；有興趣不等於說出用途。
explanation.en: Role, purpose and time make the path fit. 'Most complete' isn't your need, you don't have 4 hours a day, and interest isn't a purpose.

hint.zh: AI 知道你是誰、想用來做什麼嗎？
hint.en: Does AI know who you are and why?

scenario.zh: 保溫杯主打上班族，保溫 12 小時、放得進包包。
scenario.en: A travel mug for office workers: keeps drinks hot 12 hours, fits in a bag.

text.zh: 這款保溫杯給上班族，保溫 12 小時、放得進包包，請寫一句廣告文案。
text.en: This travel mug is for office workers, keeps drinks hot for 12 hours and fits in a bag. Write a one-line ad.

text.zh: 請寫一句有質感、打動人心、讓人想馬上買的保溫杯文案。
text.en: Write a classy, moving line that makes people want to buy the mug now.

text.zh: 我們公司成立 20 年，做過上百款杯子，還得過設計獎，請寫一句保溫杯的廣告文案。
text.en: Our company is 20 years old, has made hundreds of cups and won design awards. Write a one-line ad for the mug.

text.zh: 這款保溫杯有 5 種顏色，請寫一句廣告文案。
text.en: This travel mug comes in 5 colors. Please write a one-line ad.

explanation.zh: 產品賣點和對象是文案的原料。形容詞寫不出賣點；公司歷史、顏色數量都不是這款杯子最重要的賣點。
explanation.en: Selling points and audience are the raw material. Adjectives can't create them; company age or color count aren't the key selling points.

hint.zh: 文案的賣點從哪裡來？
hint.en: Where do the selling points come from?

scenario.zh: 新人是剛畢業的客服人員。
scenario.en: The new hire is a fresh graduate in customer service.

text.zh: 請列一份完整、全面、適合所有新人的訓練清單。
text.en: Please list a complete training plan suitable for every new hire.

text.zh: 我們公司有 300 人，請列新人第一週的訓練清單。
text.en: Our company has 300 people. List first-week training for a new hire.

text.zh: 新人很聰明、學得很快，請列第一週的訓練清單。
text.en: The new hire is smart and learns fast. List first-week training.

text.zh: 新人是剛畢業的客服人員，請列出第一週的訓練清單。
text.en: The new hire is a fresh graduate in customer service. List their first-week training.

explanation.zh: 新人的背景和職位決定要教什麼。適合所有人就不夠針對；公司人數、很聰明，都沒說他做什麼工作。
explanation.en: Background and role decide the training. 'Everyone' isn't targeted; company size or being smart doesn't say what the job is.

hint.zh: 這位新人是什麼背景？
hint.en: What's the new hire's background?

scenario.zh: 主管很忙，只想快速知道進度。
scenario.en: Your manager is busy and wants progress fast.

text.zh: 請用詳細完整的方式，把每個細節都向主管報告。
text.en: Report every detail to my manager thoroughly.

text.zh: 請用輕鬆聊天的語氣，像朋友一樣向主管報告進度。
text.en: Report progress in a casual, chatty tone, like talking to a friend.

text.zh: 請把進度做成 10 頁簡報，向主管報告。
text.en: Turn the progress into a 10-slide deck for my manager.

text.zh: 請用正式、簡潔的語氣，三句話向主管報告進度。
text.en: In a formal, concise tone, report progress to my manager in three sentences.

explanation.zh: 主管很忙，指定正式、簡潔、三句話，30 秒就看完。每個細節、10 頁簡報太長；聊天語氣不夠正式。
explanation.en: A busy manager needs formal, concise, three sentences. Every detail or 10 slides is too long; chatty isn't formal enough.

hint.zh: 主管喜歡什麼樣的報告？
hint.en: What kind of report does your manager like?

scenario.zh: 你要比較三家廠商。
scenario.en: You need to compare three vendors.

text.zh: 請分別寫三段文字，介紹三家廠商的特色。
text.en: Please write three paragraphs introducing each vendor.

text.zh: 請用表格比較三家廠商，欄位你自己決定，最好把你覺得重要的都列進去。
text.en: Compare the three vendors in a table. You choose the columns; include whatever you think matters.

text.zh: 請用表格比較三家廠商：價格、交期、售後服務。
text.en: Compare the three vendors in a table: price, lead time, after-sales service.

text.zh: 請直接告訴我該選哪一家，不用說明原因。
text.en: Just tell me which vendor to pick. No reasons needed.

explanation.zh: 表格加上你在乎的欄位，比較才一目了然。三段文字不好對照；欄位讓 AI 決定可能漏掉交期；只給答案看不到依據。
explanation.en: A table with your columns makes it instant. Paragraphs are hard to compare, AI-chosen columns may skip lead time, and a bare answer has no basis.

hint.zh: 什麼格式最適合比較？
hint.en: What format suits comparison?

scenario.zh: 品牌要在 IG 宣傳週年活動。
scenario.en: The brand is promoting its anniversary on Instagram.

text.zh: 請用正式新聞稿的格式寫 IG 貼文，顯得專業。
text.en: Write the Instagram post as a formal press release to look professional.

text.zh: 請用輕鬆活潑、加上表情符號的語氣寫 IG 貼文。
text.en: Write an Instagram post in a light, lively tone with emojis.

text.zh: 請寫一篇 IG 貼文，把活動所有細節都寫進去。
text.en: Write an Instagram post that includes every event detail.

text.zh: 請用和官網一樣的產品說明文字寫 IG 貼文。
text.en: Write the Instagram post using the same text as our website.

explanation.zh: IG 的語氣輕鬆活潑，要明講。新聞稿、官網說明太硬；寫進所有細節太長，沒人會看完。
explanation.en: Instagram is light and lively; say so. A press release or website text is stiff, and every detail is too long to read.

hint.zh: IG 上的貼文通常是什麼感覺？
hint.en: What do Instagram posts usually feel like?

scenario.zh: 你要做一份 10 頁簡報。
scenario.en: You need a 10-slide deck.

text.zh: 請整理成 10 頁簡報大綱，每頁一個標題加 3 個重點。
text.en: Turn this into a 10-slide outline, each with a title and 3 points.

text.zh: 請把內容整理成一篇 3000 字的完整報告。
text.en: Please turn this into a complete 3,000-word report.

text.zh: 請整理成簡報大綱，頁數和內容你看著辦。
text.en: Please make a slide outline. Pages and content are up to you.

text.zh: 請整理成 10 頁簡報，每一頁都放滿文字。
text.en: Please make 10 slides, each packed with text.

explanation.zh: 指定頁數和每頁結構，拿到就能開始做投影片。報告不是簡報；「看著辦」頁數不受控；每頁放滿文字不好講。
explanation.en: Slide count and structure let you start building. A report isn't slides, 'up to you' has no control, and packed slides are hard to present.

hint.zh: 每一頁要長什麼樣子？
hint.en: What should each slide look like?

scenario.zh: 你要跟爸媽解釋什麼是雲端硬碟。
scenario.en: You need to explain cloud storage to your parents.

text.zh: 請用精確的技術用語，完整解釋雲端硬碟的運作原理。
text.en: Explain precisely how cloud storage works using technical terms.

text.zh: 請用白話解釋雲端硬碟，並附上 5 個英文專有名詞。
text.en: Explain cloud storage in plain words and include 5 technical terms.

text.zh: 請比較市面上所有雲端硬碟的價格和容量。
text.en: Compare the prices and capacity of every cloud storage service.

text.zh: 請用沒有專業術語的白話，向爸媽解釋雲端硬碟。
text.en: Explain cloud storage to my parents in plain words with no jargon.

explanation.zh: 說出對象和「不要術語」，爸媽才聽得懂。技術用語、附專有名詞都更難懂；比價格不是解釋。
explanation.en: Naming the audience and 'no jargon' makes it clear. Technical terms make it harder; comparing prices isn't explaining.

hint.zh: 聽的人熟悉電腦嗎？
hint.en: Are the listeners tech-savvy?

scenario.zh: 你要發一封會議通知。
scenario.en: You're sending a meeting notice.

text.zh: 請寫一段親切的文字，邀請大家來參加會議。
text.en: Write a friendly paragraph inviting everyone to the meeting.

text.zh: 請寫會議通知，越簡短越好，一句話就夠。
text.en: Write a meeting notice as short as possible. One sentence is enough.

text.zh: 請寫成會議通知：時間、地點、議程、需準備事項。
text.en: Write it as a meeting notice: time, place, agenda, what to prepare.

text.zh: 請把會議的背景和緣由詳細寫成通知。
text.en: Write the notice explaining the meeting's background in detail.

explanation.zh: 給固定欄位，通知才不會漏資訊。親切邀請、一句話都可能漏掉時間地點；背景寫太多，重點反而找不到。
explanation.en: Fixed fields mean nothing is missed. A friendly invite or one line may skip time and place; too much background buries the key info.

hint.zh: 會議通知一定要有哪些資訊？
hint.en: What info must a notice include?

scenario.zh: 專案出錯，你要向客戶道歉。
scenario.en: A project went wrong and you're apologizing to the client.

text.zh: 請用專業的語氣寫道歉信，說明錯誤是廠商造成的。
text.en: Write a professional apology explaining the vendor caused the error.

text.zh: 請用誠懇、不推卸責任的語氣寫道歉信。
text.en: Write an apology in a sincere tone that takes responsibility.

text.zh: 請用輕鬆幽默的語氣寫道歉信，緩和一下氣氛。
text.en: Write a light, humorous apology to ease the mood.

text.zh: 請寫一封簡短的道歉信，一句「抱歉造成不便」就好。
text.en: Write a short apology. Just 'Sorry for the inconvenience' is enough.

explanation.zh: 道歉的關鍵是語氣：誠懇、不推卸。怪廠商是推卸；幽默會像不在乎；一句罐頭話不夠誠意。
explanation.en: An apology is about tone: sincere, taking responsibility. Blaming the vendor deflects, humor seems careless, and a canned line isn't sincere.

hint.zh: 道歉最需要什麼態度？
hint.en: What attitude does an apology need?

scenario.zh: 客服常被問同樣的問題。
scenario.en: Support keeps getting the same questions.

text.zh: 請整理成 Q&A 格式，共 5 題。
text.en: Organize this as a Q&A with 5 questions.

text.zh: 請寫成一篇完整的說明文章，放在官網上。
text.en: Write it as a full explanatory article for the website.

text.zh: 請整理成 Q&A 格式，把想得到的問題都列出來。
text.en: Put it in Q&A format and list every question you can think of.

text.zh: 請寫成客服人員內部使用的作業手冊。
text.en: Write it as an internal manual for support staff.

explanation.zh: Q&A 讓客戶最快找到答案，限定題數才不會太長。說明文章不好找答案；問題全列太多；內部手冊不是給客戶看的。
explanation.en: Q&A helps customers find answers fast, and a set count keeps it short. An article hides answers, every question is too many, and a manual isn't for customers.

hint.zh: 什麼格式最方便客戶找答案？
hint.en: What format helps customers find answers?

scenario.zh: 專案需要多兩週。
scenario.en: The project needs two more weeks.

text.zh: 請寫一份提案，目標是讓主管同意延長兩週。
text.en: Write a proposal whose goal is getting my manager to approve a two-week extension.

text.zh: 請寫一份提案，詳細說明專案目前遇到的所有困難。
text.en: Write a proposal detailing every problem the project has hit.

text.zh: 請寫一份提案，內容專業、格式漂亮、要有圖表。
text.en: Write a professional, nicely formatted proposal with charts.

text.zh: 請寫一份提案，目標是讓主管知道延誤不是我的錯。
text.en: Write a proposal whose goal is showing my manager the delay isn't my fault.

explanation.zh: 說出想要的結果（同意延長兩週），提案才會朝說服主管寫。列所有困難、格式漂亮沒有方向；證明不是你的錯不等於拿到時間。
explanation.en: Stating the outcome (approve two weeks) aims the proposal. Listing problems or nice formatting has no direction; proving it's not your fault doesn't get you time.

hint.zh: 提案要讓主管做什麼決定？
hint.en: What decision should your manager make?

scenario.zh: 你要應徵專案經理。
scenario.en: You're applying for a project manager role.

text.zh: 請修改我的履歷，讓它看起來更漂亮、更專業。
text.en: Revise my resume to look nicer and more professional.

text.zh: 請修改我的履歷，把做過的所有工作都寫得更詳細。
text.en: Revise my resume to describe every job in more detail.

text.zh: 請修改我的履歷，目標是讓它適合投所有工作。
text.en: Revise my resume so it works for any job.

text.zh: 請修改我的履歷，目標是更符合「專案經理」職缺。
text.en: Revise my resume to better match a 'Project Manager' opening.

explanation.zh: 有明確職缺，AI 才知道要強調哪些經歷。漂亮專業、全部寫詳細都沒有重點；適合所有工作等於沒有目標。
explanation.en: A target role tells AI what to highlight. 'Nicer' or more detail has no focus, and 'any job' is no goal at all.

hint.zh: 這份履歷要投什麼職位？
hint.en: Which role is this resume for?

scenario.zh: 下午要開會決定新產品名稱。
scenario.en: This afternoon's meeting must pick a product name.

text.zh: 請設計會議議程，讓每個人都能充分發表意見，不要限制發言時間。
text.en: Design an agenda where everyone can fully share their views, with no time limit on speaking.

text.zh: 請設計一個完整的議程，包含開場、討論和總結。
text.en: Design a complete agenda with an opening, discussion and wrap-up.

text.zh: 請設計會議議程，目標是 30 分鐘內決定新產品名稱。
text.en: Design an agenda whose goal is choosing a product name within 30 minutes.

text.zh: 請設計會議議程，目標是想出越多名字越好。
text.en: Design an agenda whose goal is coming up with as many names as possible.

explanation.zh: 目標是「30 分鐘內決定」，議程才會聚焦在收斂。人人充分發言可能超時；有頭有尾是格式不是目標；想越多名字只發散不收斂。
explanation.en: The goal 'decide in 30 minutes' focuses on converging. Everyone speaking fully runs over, structure isn't a goal, and more names only diverges.

hint.zh: 會議結束時要得到什麼？
hint.en: What should you have when the meeting ends?

scenario.zh: 客戶一直沒回報價。
scenario.en: A client hasn't replied to your quote.

text.zh: 請寫一封信，禮貌地問候客戶最近好不好。
text.en: Write an email politely asking how the client has been.

text.zh: 請寫這封信，目標是讓客戶在週五前回覆報價。
text.en: Write this email with the goal of getting the client to reply to the quote by Friday.

text.zh: 請寫一封信，再完整介紹一次我們的報價內容。
text.en: Write an email re-explaining our quote in full.

text.zh: 請寫一封信，表達我們很重視這次的合作。
text.en: Write an email saying how much we value this partnership.

explanation.zh: 目標和期限明確，信才會有清楚的行動要求。問候、重新介紹、表達重視都很客氣，但客戶看完不知道要做什麼。
explanation.en: A clear goal and deadline create a clear ask. Greetings, re-explaining or valuing the partnership are polite, but the client won't know what to do.

hint.zh: 你希望客戶看完做什麼？
hint.en: What should the client do after reading?

scenario.zh: 新人老是不會用報帳系統。
scenario.en: New hires keep struggling with the expense system.

text.zh: 請設計練習，目標是讓新人能自己完成報帳。
text.en: Design practice so new hires can file expenses on their own.

text.zh: 請把報帳系統的所有功能整理成一份說明文件。
text.en: Document every feature of the expense system.

text.zh: 請設計一堂 2 小時的報帳系統介紹課程。
text.en: Design a 2-hour introduction class on the expense system.

text.zh: 請列出新人報帳最常犯的 10 個錯誤。
text.en: List the 10 most common expense mistakes new hires make.

explanation.zh: 目標是「能自己完成」，所以要動手練習。說明文件、介紹課程、錯誤清單都是看和聽，不保證會做。
explanation.en: The goal is doing it alone, so hands-on practice. Docs, a class or a mistake list are reading and listening, not doing.

hint.zh: 新人要做到什麼程度？
hint.en: What should new hires be able to do?

scenario.zh: 新產品要附一頁說明。
scenario.en: A new product needs a one-page guide.

text.zh: 請寫產品說明，把所有功能和規格都寫進去。
text.en: Write a product guide covering every feature and spec.

text.zh: 請寫產品說明，用詞要專業、多用技術名詞，讓客戶覺得我們很厲害。
text.en: Write a product guide in professional terms with lots of technical words so clients think we're impressive.

text.zh: 請寫產品說明，長度剛好一頁 A4 紙。
text.en: Write a product guide exactly one A4 page long.

text.zh: 請寫產品說明，要讓沒用過的人 1 分鐘看懂。
text.en: Write a product guide a first-time user can understand in 1 minute.

explanation.zh: 說出「怎樣才算好」（1 分鐘看懂），AI 才知道要多簡單。寫進所有功能太多；專業用詞更難懂；一頁 A4 只限制長度，沒說要讓誰看懂。
explanation.en: Saying what 'good' means (understood in 1 minute) sets simplicity. Every feature is too much, jargon is harder, and one page limits length, not clarity.

hint.zh: 成功的標準是什麼？
hint.en: What's the success standard?

scenario.zh: 你收到 200 份客戶問卷。
scenario.en: You got 200 customer surveys.

text.zh: 請把問卷的每一題都做成圓餅圖。
text.en: Make a pie chart for every survey question.

text.zh: 請完整分析這份問卷，越詳細越好。
text.en: Analyze this survey fully, in as much detail as possible.

text.zh: 請分析問卷，找出客戶最不滿意的前 3 項。
text.en: Analyze the surveys and find customers' top 3 complaints.

text.zh: 請找出客戶最滿意的地方，做成宣傳素材。
text.en: Find what customers liked most and turn it into marketing material.

explanation.zh: 目標明確，分析才不會變成一堆數字。每題做圖、越詳細越好都沒有重點；最滿意的地方不是你想解決的問題。
explanation.en: A clear goal keeps analysis from being a pile of numbers. A chart per question or max detail has no focus; what customers liked isn't the problem to solve.

hint.zh: 你最想從問卷知道什麼？
hint.en: What do you most want to learn?

scenario.zh: 老闆只有 5 分鐘聽你報告。
scenario.en: Your boss has only 5 minutes for your update.

text.zh: 請調整簡報，讓設計更美觀、配色更一致。
text.en: Adjust the deck so the design looks nicer and colors match.

text.zh: 請調整簡報，目標是讓老闆 5 分鐘內能做決定。
text.en: Adjust the deck so my boss can decide within 5 minutes.

text.zh: 請調整簡報，補充更多背景資料讓老闆更了解。
text.en: Adjust the deck with more background so my boss understands better.

text.zh: 請調整簡報，把所有數據都放進去以示完整。
text.en: Adjust the deck to include all the data to show we're thorough.

explanation.zh: 目標是「做決定」，AI 會把結論和選項放前面。美化、補背景、塞滿數據，都會讓老闆 5 分鐘內更難決定。
explanation.en: The goal is a decision, so conclusions come first. Polishing, more background or all the data make a 5-minute decision harder.

hint.zh: 老闆看完要做什麼？
hint.en: What should your boss do after seeing it?

scenario.zh: 你有一篇很喜歡的舊產品介紹。
scenario.en: You have an old product description you love.

text.zh: 請寫新產品的介紹，要寫得比以前所有的產品介紹都更好、更吸引人。
text.en: Write the new product description, better and more appealing than every one before it.

text.zh: 請照這篇範例的長度和語氣，寫新產品的介紹。
text.en: Match this sample's length and tone to write the new product description.

text.zh: 請寫新產品的介紹，風格你自由發揮就好。
text.en: Write the new product description in any style you like.

text.zh: 請照這篇範例，把產品名稱換掉就好。
text.en: Use this sample and just swap in the new product name.

explanation.zh: 給範例並說要參考長度和語氣，AI 就能對齊你的風格。「比以前好」「自由發揮」沒有標準；只換名稱就是抄舊文。
explanation.en: A sample plus 'match length and tone' aligns the style. 'Better' or 'any style' has no standard; swapping the name is copying.

hint.zh: 有沒有現成的好例子可以給 AI？
hint.en: Is there a good example to give AI?

scenario.zh: 你想問合約裡的付款條件。
scenario.en: You want to ask about payment terms in a contract.

text.zh: 請只根據附件合約回答；合約沒寫的，就說「未提及」。
text.en: Answer only from the attached contract; if it's not there, say 'Not mentioned.'

text.zh: 請根據附件合約回答，不清楚的地方就依一般商業慣例補充。
text.en: Answer from the attached contract, filling unclear parts with common practice.

text.zh: 請根據附件合約回答，並加上你的法律建議。
text.en: Answer from the attached contract and add your legal advice.

text.zh: 請詳細回答付款條件的相關問題，越完整越好。
text.en: Answer questions about payment terms in as much detail as possible.

explanation.zh: 限定來源並說好沒寫時怎麼辦，才不會編出合約沒有的條款。用慣例補、加法律建議、越完整越好，都可能混進合約以外的內容。
explanation.en: Limit the source and say what to do if missing. Common practice, legal advice or 'max detail' can all mix in things outside the contract.

hint.zh: 答案只能從哪裡來？
hint.en: Where must the answer come from?

scenario.zh: 簡介要放在海報上，不想要誇張用詞。
scenario.en: The blurb goes on a poster; you don't want hype words.

text.zh: 請寫一段吸引人的活動簡介，讓大家都想報名。
text.en: Write an appealing event blurb that makes everyone want to sign up.

text.zh: 請寫一段 50 字以內的活動簡介，用最吸睛、最有衝擊力的字眼讓大家想報名。
text.en: Write an event blurb under 50 words, using the most eye-catching, powerful words to drive sign-ups.

text.zh: 請寫活動簡介，不要太長，也不要太短。
text.en: Write an event blurb, not too long and not too short.

text.zh: 請寫 50 字以內的活動簡介，不要用「革命性」這類誇張詞。
text.en: Write an event blurb under 50 words, without hype words like 'revolutionary'.

explanation.zh: 字數限制加上「不要什麼」，結果才接近你要的。只說吸引人、越吸睛越好，容易出現誇張詞；「不要太長也不要太短」沒有標準。
explanation.en: A word limit plus a 'don't' gets close. 'Appealing' or 'eye-catching' invites hype, and 'not too long or short' has no standard.

hint.zh: 有哪些限制要先講？
hint.en: Which limits should you state first?

scenario.zh: 兩個方案，你要選一個。
scenario.en: Two options — you need to pick one.

text.zh: 請全面比較兩個方案，列出所有的差異。
text.en: Compare the two options fully, listing every difference.

text.zh: 請比較兩個方案，然後直接告訴我該選哪個。
text.en: Compare the two options and just tell me which to pick.

text.zh: 請用「成本、時間、風險」三個標準比較兩個方案。
text.en: Compare the two options on cost, time and risk.

text.zh: 請比較兩個方案，看哪個比較有創意。
text.en: Compare the two options by which is more creative.

explanation.zh: 給判斷標準，比較才有依據。列所有差異沒有重點；直接給答案看不到理由；有創意不是你這次的判斷標準。
explanation.en: Criteria give the comparison a basis. Every difference has no focus, a bare pick has no reasons, and creativity isn't your criterion here.

hint.zh: 你用什麼標準做決定？
hint.en: What criteria decide it for you?

scenario.zh: 客戶留言一大堆，要分類。
scenario.en: You have a flood of customer comments to categorize.

text.zh: 請把留言分類，要分幾類由你判斷。
text.en: Categorize the comments. You decide how many categories.

text.zh: 請把留言分成稱讚、抱怨、建議；例如「出貨太慢」算抱怨。
text.en: Sort comments into praise, complaint, suggestion; e.g. 'Shipping is slow' is a complaint.

text.zh: 請把留言分成正面和負面兩類。
text.en: Sort the comments into positive and negative.

text.zh: 請把所有客戶留言整理好，分成稱讚、抱怨、建議三類，每一類再依數量排序。
text.en: Sort all the customer comments into praise, complaint and suggestion, and rank each group by count.

explanation.zh: 分類加上一個例子，AI 分得最準。自己判斷類別會亂；正負兩類看不出建議；只給類別沒給例子，模糊的留言容易分錯。
explanation.en: Categories plus an example sort most accurately. AI-chosen categories vary, positive/negative hides suggestions, and without an example vague comments get misfiled.

hint.zh: 分類規則可以舉例嗎？
hint.en: Can you give an example of the rule?

scenario.zh: 你想潤飾一段文字，裡面有日期和金額。
scenario.en: You want to polish text that contains dates and amounts.

text.zh: 請潤飾這段文字，但不要改動任何數字和日期。
text.en: Polish this text, but don't change any numbers or dates.

text.zh: 請潤飾這段文字，讓它更專業、更流暢。
text.en: Polish this text to be more professional and fluent.

text.zh: 請潤飾這段文字，數字可以改成約略值比較好讀。
text.en: Polish this text, and round the numbers so they're easier to read.

text.zh: 請把這段文字重寫一遍，意思差不多就好。
text.en: Rewrite this text. Roughly the same meaning is fine.

explanation.zh: 說出「不要改什麼」，重要資訊才不會被改掉。只說更專業、改成約略值、意思差不多，都可能動到數字和日期。
explanation.en: Saying what not to change protects key info. 'More professional', rounding or 'roughly the same' can all alter numbers and dates.

hint.zh: 哪些東西一定不能動？
hint.en: What must stay untouched?

scenario.zh: 今年要寫活動報告。
scenario.en: You need this year's event report.

text.zh: 請寫今年的活動報告，格式要新穎、跟以前不一樣。
text.en: Write this year's event report in a fresh format, different from before.

text.zh: 請寫今年的活動報告，內容越豐富越好。
text.en: Write this year's event report with as much content as possible.

text.zh: 請直接把去年的報告改個日期當今年的。
text.en: Just change the date on last year's report and use it.

text.zh: 請參考去年的活動報告格式，寫今年的報告。
text.en: Follow last year's event report format for this year's report.

explanation.zh: 沿用參考格式，報告前後一致，主管也好比較。新格式沒辦法比較；內容豐富沒有格式；只改日期就是舊報告。
explanation.en: Reusing the format keeps reports consistent and comparable. A new format can't be compared, 'rich content' has no format, and changing the date is the old report.

hint.zh: 有沒有現成格式可以沿用？
hint.en: Is there an existing format to reuse?

scenario.zh: 要規劃員工旅遊。
scenario.en: You're planning a company outing.

text.zh: 請推薦三個最多人去、評價最好的員工旅遊地點。
text.en: Suggest three of the most popular, best-rated company trip spots.

text.zh: 請推薦三個員工旅遊地點，預算不是問題。
text.en: Suggest three company trip spots. Budget isn't an issue.

text.zh: 員工旅遊每人預算 3000 元以內，請推薦三個地點。
text.en: Budget is under 3,000 NTD per person. Suggest three destinations for a company outing.

text.zh: 請推薦三個員工旅遊地點，越便宜越好。
text.en: Suggest three company trip spots, the cheaper the better.

explanation.zh: 預算是限制條件，要講清楚數字。最熱門可能超預算；「不是問題」不符合事實；越便宜越好可能品質太差。
explanation.en: The budget is a constraint; give the number. Popular may exceed it, 'not an issue' isn't true, and cheapest may be poor quality.

hint.zh: 有什麼限制是 AI 要知道的？
hint.en: What limits does AI need to know?

scenario.zh: 這個月營收下降 15%。
scenario.en: Revenue fell 15% this month.

text.zh: 請直接給我三個能讓營收回升的方法。
text.en: Just give me three ways to get revenue back up.

text.zh: 請把這個月的營收數字做成圖表。
text.en: Turn this month's revenue numbers into a chart.

text.zh: 請先列出可能原因，再依影響大小排序，最後建議處理方式。
text.en: First list possible causes, then rank them by impact, then suggest actions.

text.zh: 請分析營收下降的原因，想到什麼就寫什麼，市場、產品、人員、季節都可以談。
text.en: Analyze why revenue dropped. Write whatever comes to mind: market, product, staff, season, anything.

explanation.zh: 先原因、再排序、後建議，思考才有條理。直接給方法沒找原因；做圖表沒分析；想到什麼寫什麼沒有順序。
explanation.en: Causes, ranking, then suggestions. Jumping to fixes skips causes, a chart isn't analysis, and free writing has no order.

hint.zh: 要 AI 照什麼順序想？
hint.en: In what order should AI think?

scenario.zh: 你要寫一份 10 頁的報告。
scenario.en: You need to write a 10-page report.

text.zh: 請直接寫完 10 頁報告，我再一次看完修改。
text.en: Write the full 10 pages, and I'll review it all at once.

text.zh: 請先給我大綱，我確認後再寫各段內容。
text.en: Give me an outline first; after I approve it, write each section.

text.zh: 請先寫結論，其他部分之後再補。
text.en: Write the conclusion first and fill in the rest later.

text.zh: 請給我 3 個報告標題讓我先挑。
text.en: Give me 3 report titles to pick from first.

explanation.zh: 先確認大綱，就不會寫完才發現方向錯。一次寫完改起來最累；先寫結論沒有架構；標題不是這一步的重點。
explanation.en: Approving an outline first avoids a wrong direction. All at once is hardest to fix, conclusion-first lacks structure, and titles aren't the point.

hint.zh: 哪一步可以先檢查？
hint.en: Which step can you check first?

scenario.zh: 公司要導入新的請假系統。
scenario.en: The company is rolling out a new leave system.

text.zh: 請把導入分成準備、試用、正式上線三階段，每階段列重點。
text.en: Split the rollout into prepare, pilot, go-live, with key points for each.

text.zh: 請列出導入新系統需要注意的 20 件事。
text.en: List 20 things to watch out for in the rollout.

text.zh: 請寫一封信，通知全公司所有部門，下週一起全部改用新的請假系統。
text.en: Write an email telling every department to switch completely to the new leave system from next Monday.

text.zh: 請比較新舊請假系統的功能差異。
text.en: Compare the features of the old and new leave systems.

explanation.zh: 分階段規劃，每一步要做什麼才清楚。20 件事沒有順序；直接全面上線風險高；功能比較不是導入計畫。
explanation.en: Phases make each step clear. 20 items have no order, switching everyone at once is risky, and a feature comparison isn't a rollout plan.

hint.zh: 可以分成幾個階段？
hint.en: How many phases can it split into?

scenario.zh: 你給了 AI 三個要求。
scenario.en: You gave AI three requirements.

text.zh: 請寫仔細一點，不要出錯。
text.en: Please be careful and don't make mistakes.

text.zh: 請寫完後自己評分，滿分 10 分，如果低於 8 分就再寫一次。
text.en: When done, rate your own work out of 10, and if it's under 8, write it again.

text.zh: 請寫兩個版本讓我比較看看。
text.en: Write two versions for me to compare.

text.zh: 寫完後，請對照我的 3 個要求逐項檢查一次。
text.en: When done, check the result against my 3 requirements one by one.

explanation.zh: 加上具體的檢查步驟，比說「仔細一點」有效。「不要出錯」沒有方法；自評分數不會對照要求；兩個版本不等於有檢查。
explanation.en: A concrete check step beats 'be careful'. 'No mistakes' has no method, a self-score doesn't check requirements, and two versions aren't a check.

hint.zh: 怎麼讓 AI 自己檢查？
hint.en: How can AI check its own work?

scenario.zh: 你在兩個方案間猶豫。
scenario.en: You're torn between two options.

text.zh: 請直接告訴我該選哪一個就好。
text.en: Just tell me which one to pick.

text.zh: 請把兩個方案各自的所有細節，包括成本、時程、人力都完整列出來。
text.en: List every detail of both options, including cost, timeline and staffing, in full.

text.zh: 請先列出每個方案的優缺點，再給建議和理由。
text.en: First list pros and cons of each, then give a recommendation with reasons.

text.zh: 請再給我第三個方案參考看看。
text.en: Give me a third option to consider.

explanation.zh: 先比較、再建議，你才看得到判斷過程。只給答案看不到理由；只列細節沒有結論；多一個方案讓選擇更難。
explanation.en: Compare, then recommend, so you see the reasoning. A bare pick has no reasons, details have no conclusion, and a third option makes it harder.

hint.zh: 想看到 AI 怎麼想的嗎？
hint.en: Do you want to see how AI thinks?

scenario.zh: 一個月後要辦活動。
scenario.en: You're hosting an event in a month.

text.zh: 請列出辦這場活動需要做的所有事情。
text.en: List everything needed to run the event.

text.zh: 請從活動日往回推，列出前 4 週每週要完成的事。
text.en: Work backward from the event date and list what to finish each of the 4 weeks before.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一份完整的活動企劃書。
text.en: Write a complete event proposal for me.

text.zh: 請告訴我辦活動最容易出錯的地方。
text.en: Tell me what usually goes wrong at events.

explanation.zh: 倒推時程，每週該做什麼一目了然。所有事情沒有時間順序；企劃書和注意事項都不是時程。
explanation.en: Planning backward shows what's due each week. An everything-list has no timing; a proposal or pitfalls aren't a schedule.

hint.zh: 怎麼排時間最不會來不及？
hint.en: How do you schedule so nothing's late?

scenario.zh: 一份銷售資料有重複和缺漏。
scenario.en: Sales data has duplicates and gaps.

text.zh: 請先刪掉重複資料，再統計各區銷售額，最後指出重點。
text.en: First remove duplicates, then total sales by region, then point out key findings.

text.zh: 請直接統計各區銷售額並做成圖表。
text.en: Total sales by region and chart it right away.

text.zh: 請找出銷售最好的那一區就好。
text.en: Just find the best-selling region.

text.zh: 請先指出重點，再回頭檢查資料。
text.en: Point out key findings first, then check the data.

explanation.zh: 先清理、再統計、後解讀，結果才正確。沒清掉重複資料就統計會算錯；只找最好的一區不夠；先下結論順序反了。
explanation.en: Clean, total, then interpret. Totaling before removing duplicates is wrong, one region isn't enough, and conclusions first is backward.

hint.zh: 資料要先處理什麼？
hint.en: What must be done to the data first?

scenario.zh: 客戶抱怨出貨太慢。
scenario.en: A customer complains shipping is slow.

text.zh: 請先詳細說明我們的出貨流程和這次延遲的經過，最後再跟客戶道歉。
text.en: First explain our shipping process and what caused this delay in detail, then apologize at the end.

text.zh: 請寫一封回信，把公司政策完整附上。
text.en: Write a reply and attach the full company policy.

text.zh: 請寫一封回信，直接提供折價券就好。
text.en: Write a reply that just offers a coupon.

text.zh: 請照「道歉→說明原因→提出補償」的順序寫回信。
text.en: Write the reply in this order: apologize → explain the cause → offer compensation.

explanation.zh: 先道歉、再說明、最後補償，客戶感受最好。先講流程像在找藉口；附政策太生硬；只給折價券沒有誠意也沒解釋。
explanation.en: Apologize, explain, compensate. Process first sounds like excuses, a policy dump is cold, and a coupon alone lacks sincerity.

hint.zh: 回信可以照什麼順序寫？
hint.en: What order could the reply follow?

scenario.zh: HR 要寫歡迎信給新同事。
scenario.en: HR is writing a welcome letter to a new colleague.

text.zh: 請寫一封溫暖、專業、讓新同事感動的歡迎信。
text.en: Write a warm, professional welcome letter that moves the new colleague.

text.zh: 我是 HR，請寫一封歡迎信，盡量完整，提到公司所有福利。
text.en: I'm in HR. Write a welcome letter covering all company benefits in full.

text.zh: 請寫一封 300 字以內的歡迎信，語氣要溫暖。
text.en: Write a warm welcome letter under 300 words.

text.zh: 我是 HR，請寫新同事歡迎信，語氣溫暖、300 字內，並提醒第一天 9 點報到。
text.en: I'm in HR. Write a warm welcome letter for a new colleague, under 300 words, reminding them to report at 9 a.m. on day one.

explanation.zh: 任務、背景、語氣、長度、必要資訊都有，一次到位。形容詞不是資訊；所有福利太長；少了報到時間這個必要資訊。
explanation.en: Task, background, tone, length and must-have info. Adjectives aren't info, every benefit is too long, and one option misses the 9 a.m. start.

hint.zh: 哪一句 ACTORS 元素最多又最清楚？
hint.en: Which one has the most ACTORS parts, stated clearly?

scenario.zh: AI 引用了一份你查不到的研究。
scenario.en: AI cited a study you can't find.

text.zh: AI 引用的應該有根據，我直接放進報告。
text.en: AI probably has a source, so I'll put it straight into the report.

text.zh: 請把這份研究的結論改寫得更有說服力。
text.en: Rewrite this study's conclusion to be more persuasive.

text.zh: 請提供這份研究的出處；找不到就標示為「無法確認」。
text.en: Give me the source for this study; if you can't find it, mark it 'unverified'.

text.zh: 請再多找幾份結論類似的研究，一起放進報告裡來支持這個論點。
text.en: Find a few more studies with similar conclusions and add them all to the report to back this up.

explanation.zh: AI 可能編造資料，要求出處，找不到就不要用。直接用、改寫、找更多「類似研究」，都可能讓假資料更多。
explanation.en: AI can invent sources. Ask for one and drop it if unverified. Using it, rewriting it or finding 'similar studies' can multiply fake data.

hint.zh: 這份資料可以直接用嗎？
hint.en: Can you use this data as-is?

scenario.zh: AI 給的建議太籠統，用不上。
scenario.en: AI's advice is too vague to use.

text.zh: 請再詳細一點，多給我一些建議。
text.en: More detail, please. Give me more suggestions.

text.zh: 請針對我們 20 人的門市，給 3 個本週就能做的具體做法。
text.en: For our 20-person retail store, give 3 specific actions we can take this week.

text.zh: 請用更專業的角度重新回答一次。
text.en: Answer again from a more professional angle.

text.zh: 請給我 10 個國際知名企業都在用的業界最佳實務做法，越詳細越好。
text.en: Give me 10 best practices used by famous global companies, in as much detail as possible.

explanation.zh: 補上你的情況和「具體、本週可做」，建議才能落地。多給、更專業、業界最佳實務，都還是通用建議。
explanation.en: Adding your situation and 'specific, this week' makes it actionable. More, more professional or best practices are still generic.

hint.zh: 要怎麼讓建議變具體？
hint.en: How do you make advice concrete?

scenario.zh: 你想請 AI 摘要一份客戶合約。
scenario.en: You want AI to summarize a client contract.

text.zh: 先把客戶名稱、金額等機密資訊遮掉，再貼給 AI。
text.en: First mask client names, amounts and other confidential details, then paste it.

text.zh: 只貼合約的前半段，有金額的後半段就不貼。
text.en: Paste only the first half; skip the part with amounts.

text.zh: 貼上完整合約，最後加一句「請保密」。
text.en: Paste the full contract and add 'please keep this confidential'.

text.zh: 貼上完整合約，用完再把對話刪掉就好。
text.en: Paste the full contract and delete the chat afterward.

explanation.zh: 機密資料先去識別化再使用，才能保護客戶和公司。只貼一半可能還有客戶名稱；叫 AI 保密、事後刪對話都收不回已送出的資料。
explanation.en: De-identify confidential data first. Half the contract may still name the client, and asking for secrecy or deleting later can't recall what was sent.

hint.zh: 貼給 AI 之前要先做什麼？
hint.en: What should you do before pasting?

scenario.zh: AI 寫的文案太長，但第一句很好。
scenario.en: AI's copy is too long, but the first sentence is great.

text.zh: 請縮短一點。
text.en: Make it a bit shorter.

text.zh: 請重新寫一個比較短、比較精簡、比較有力的版本。
text.en: Please rewrite a shorter, tighter, punchier version of the whole thing for me.

text.zh: 請把整段縮短成 30 字以內。
text.en: Shorten the whole thing to under 30 words.

text.zh: 請保留第一句，其餘縮短成 30 字以內。
text.en: Keep the first sentence and shorten the rest to under 30 words.

explanation.zh: 說清楚保留什麼、改成多長，一次就改對。「短一點」沒有標準；重寫、整段縮短都可能把你喜歡的第一句改掉。
explanation.en: Say what to keep and how short. 'A bit shorter' has no standard; rewriting or shortening everything may lose the first sentence you liked.

hint.zh: 哪裡要留？改成多長？
hint.en: What stays, and how short?

scenario.zh: AI 算出來的總額看起來不對。
scenario.en: AI's total looks wrong.

text.zh: 請再算一次，確認一下。
text.en: Calculate it again to confirm.

text.zh: 你算錯了，請重新計算，並直接給我正確的總額。
text.en: You got it wrong. Recalculate and just give me the correct total, please.

text.zh: 請列出計算過程，讓我逐項核對。
text.en: Show the calculation step by step so I can check each item.

text.zh: 請把總額四捨五入到千位就好。
text.en: Just round the total to the nearest thousand.

explanation.zh: 看到計算過程，才能找出哪一步錯，也能確認結果。再算一次可能錯在同一個地方；只要總額還是無法核對；四捨五入沒解決問題。
explanation.en: Seeing the steps shows where it went wrong. Recalculating may repeat the error, a new total still can't be checked, and rounding fixes nothing.

hint.zh: 要怎麼確認數字對不對？
hint.en: How can you confirm the number?

scenario.zh: 明天要向客戶提案。
scenario.en: You're pitching to a client tomorrow.

question.en: Which one helps you prepare most?

text.zh: 請看看我的提案，多給一些正面的回饋和鼓勵，讓我明天更有信心上台。
text.en: Look at my proposal and give lots of positive feedback and encouragement so I feel confident tomorrow.

text.zh: 請扮演挑剔的客戶，指出這份提案最可能被拒絕的 3 個原因。
text.en: Play a tough client and point out the 3 most likely reasons this proposal gets rejected.

text.zh: 請幫我把提案的文字修得更漂亮。
text.en: Polish the wording of my proposal.

text.zh: 請列出一份好提案應該具備的 10 個要素。
text.en: List 10 things every good proposal should have.

explanation.zh: 讓 AI 從客戶角度挑毛病，能提前補強弱點。正面回饋、修文字、通用要素，都找不出這份提案的問題。
explanation.en: Having AI critique as the client exposes weaknesses early. Praise, polishing or a generic checklist won't find this proposal's problems.

hint.zh: 誰的角度最能找出問題？
hint.en: Whose view finds problems best?

scenario.zh: 附件是上季銷售數據，要給主管看。
scenario.en: The attachment is last quarter's sales data for your manager.

text.zh: 根據附件數據，用表格列出上季前 3 名產品，並用一句話說明原因。
text.en: From the attached data, make a table of last quarter's top 3 products, with one sentence on why.

text.zh: 請分析附件的所有銷售數據，把每一項發現都寫成一份完整、詳細的報告。
text.en: Analyze all the attached sales data and write up every single finding in a complete, detailed report.

text.zh: 請根據附件數據，告訴我哪個產品賣最好。
text.en: From the attached data, tell me which product sold best.

text.zh: 請用表格列出上季的前 3 名產品。
text.en: Make a table of last quarter's top 3 products.

explanation.zh: 資料來源、格式、範圍、說明方式都有，主管一看就懂。完整報告太長；只問賣最好少了格式和原因；沒說依據附件、也沒說明原因。
explanation.en: Source, format, scope and explanation. A full report is too long, 'best seller' lacks format and reasons, and one option has no source or why.

hint.zh: 資料、格式、範圍都說了嗎？
hint.en: Did you state data, format and scope?

scenario.zh: 你想請 AI 幫你認識暴龍。
scenario.en: You want AI to help you learn about the T. rex.

question.zh: 哪一句最清楚說出要 AI 做什麼？
question.en: Which one clearly tells AI what to do?

text.zh: 請用 5 句話介紹暴龍吃什麼、住在哪裡。
text.en: In 5 sentences, tell me what a T. rex ate and where it lived.

text.zh: 我對暴龍超有興趣，牠吃什麼、住在哪裡我都好想知道喔！
text.en: I'm super into T. rex and really want to know what it ate and where it lived!

text.zh: 暴龍、吃什麼、住哪裡、5 句話、要簡單，資料越多越好。
text.en: T. rex, food, home, 5 sentences, simple, as much info as possible.

text.zh: 請幫我畫一張暴龍在森林裡大口吃東西的圖。
text.en: Please draw a picture of a T. rex eating in a forest.

explanation.zh: 正解有動作（介紹）也有內容。只說「好想知道」、只丟關鍵字，AI 都要用猜的；畫圖是另一件事。
explanation.en: The answer has an action (tell me) and content. Saying you're curious or listing keywords makes AI guess; drawing is a different task.

hint.zh: 找找看，哪一句有「要 AI 做的動作」？
hint.en: Look for the one with an action for AI to do.

scenario.zh: 媽媽生日快到了，你想請 AI 幫忙。
scenario.en: Mom's birthday is coming, and you want AI's help.

text.zh: 媽媽下週生日，她很辛苦，我想讓她知道我很愛她。
text.en: Mom's birthday is next week. She works so hard and I want her to know I love her.

text.zh: 請推薦適合送媽媽的生日禮物，預算 300 元以內。
text.en: Please suggest a birthday gift for Mom under 300 NTD.

text.zh: 請告訴我生日卡片通常要寫哪些內容比較好。
text.en: Please tell me what people usually write in a birthday card.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一張給媽媽的生日卡片。
text.en: Please write a birthday card for my mom.

explanation.zh: 你要的是卡片，就直接請 AI「寫卡片」。推薦禮物、教你怎麼寫是別的任務；只說心意沒有請它做事。
explanation.en: You want a card, so ask AI to write one. Gift ideas or tips are different tasks, and sharing feelings asks for nothing.

hint.zh: 你想要 AI 最後交給你什麼？
hint.en: What do you want AI to give you in the end?

scenario.en: You don't know how to solve 3/4 + 1/8.

question.zh: 哪一句最能得到你要的幫忙？
question.en: Which one gets you the help you need?

text.zh: 請直接告訴我 3/4 + 1/8 的答案，我要寫作業。
text.en: Just tell me the answer to 3/4 + 1/8. It's for homework.

text.zh: 分數加法好難，我每次算 3/4 + 1/8 這種題目都錯。
text.en: Adding fractions is so hard. I always get ones like 3/4 + 1/8 wrong.

text.zh: 請一步一步教我算 3/4 + 1/8。
text.en: Please teach me step by step how to solve 3/4 + 1/8.

text.zh: 請出 5 題跟 3/4 + 1/8 一樣的分數題給我。
text.en: Please give me 5 more problems like 3/4 + 1/8.

explanation.zh: 你想學會，就請 AI「一步一步教」。只給答案學不會；出新題目是另一件事；只抱怨沒有請它做事。
explanation.en: You want to learn, so ask AI to teach step by step. The answer alone won't teach you; new problems are a different task; complaining asks for nothing.

hint.zh: 你要 AI 教你，還是出新題目？
hint.en: Do you want AI to teach you, or to give you a new problem?

scenario.zh: 你想聽一個睡前小故事。
scenario.en: You want a short bedtime story.

text.zh: 我今天好累想早點睡，小貓和交朋友是我最喜歡的。
text.en: I'm tired and want to sleep early. Kittens and friends are my favorite.

text.zh: 請寫一個小貓找朋友的短故事。
text.en: Please write a short story about a kitten looking for a friend.

text.zh: 請推薦 3 本適合睡前看的小貓繪本給我。
text.en: Please recommend 3 bedtime picture books about kittens.

text.zh: 請告訴我一個好故事需要哪些部分。
text.en: Please tell me what parts a good story needs.

explanation.zh: 你要聽故事，就請 AI「寫故事」並說主角。推薦繪本、講故事技巧都不是你要的；說喜歡什麼沒有請它做事。
explanation.en: You want a story, so ask AI to write one and name the hero. Book picks or story tips aren't what you need, and listing likes asks for nothing.

hint.zh: 哪一句有動作又有主角？
hint.en: Which one has an action and a main character?

scenario.zh: 自然課上，你想知道植物為什麼需要陽光。
scenario.en: In science class, you wonder why plants need sunlight.

text.zh: 請說明植物為什麼需要陽光。
text.en: Please explain why plants need sunlight.

text.zh: 植物需要陽光，課本上也有寫，我覺得好神奇。
text.en: Plants need sunlight. It's in our textbook and I think it's amazing.

text.zh: 請畫一張植物在陽光下慢慢長大的圖給我看。
text.en: Please draw a plant slowly growing in the sun.

text.zh: 請列出 10 種最喜歡陽光的植物名字。
text.en: Please list 10 plants that love sunlight the most.

explanation.zh: 你想知道「為什麼」，就請 AI「說明原因」。畫圖、列植物名字都沒回答為什麼；說很神奇沒有請它做事。
explanation.en: You want to know why, so ask AI to explain. A drawing or a list doesn't answer why, and saying it's amazing asks for nothing.

hint.zh: 你想知道的是原因，還是一張圖？
hint.en: Do you want a reason or a picture?

scenario.zh: 班上要做「愛護地球」海報。
scenario.en: Your class is making a 'Love the Earth' poster.

text.zh: 我們班要做愛護地球的海報，大家都很想做好。
text.en: Our class is making a 'Love the Earth' poster and we want it to be great.

text.zh: 請告訴我愛護地球的海報用什麼顏色最好看。
text.en: Please tell me which colors look best on an Earth poster.

text.zh: 請寫一篇 300 字介紹地球暖化的文章。
text.en: Please write a 300-word article about global warming.

text.zh: 請幫我想 3 句愛護地球的海報標語。
text.en: Please give me 3 slogans for a 'Love the Earth' poster.

explanation.zh: 海報需要標語，所以請 AI「想標語」並說數量。挑顏色、寫文章都不是標語；只說要做海報沒有請它做事。
explanation.en: The poster needs slogans, so ask for slogans and how many. Colors or an article aren't slogans, and just mentioning the poster asks for nothing.

hint.zh: 海報上最需要的是什麼？
hint.en: What does the poster need most?

scenario.zh: 你想背水果的英文單字。
scenario.en: You want to learn fruit words in English.

text.zh: 我想背水果的英文，可是蘋果、香蕉老是記不住。
text.en: I want to learn fruit words, but I keep forgetting apple and banana.

text.zh: 請用英文寫一篇介紹水果營養的短文。
text.en: Please write a short English article about fruit nutrition.

text.zh: 請列出 10 個水果的英文和中文。
text.en: Please list 10 fruits in English and Chinese.

text.zh: 請告訴我背英文單字有哪些好方法。
text.en: Please tell me good ways to memorize English words.

explanation.zh: 你要的是單字表，就請 AI「列出」。寫短文、教方法都不是單字表；只說記不住沒有請它做事。
explanation.en: You want a word list, so ask AI to list. An article or tips aren't a list, and saying you forget asks for nothing.

hint.zh: 哪一句會讓 AI 真的給你單字？
hint.en: Which one will really get you a word list?

scenario.zh: 明天要去郊遊。
scenario.en: You're going on a field trip tomorrow.

text.zh: 明天要去郊遊，我好興奮，可是很怕忘記帶東西。
text.en: Tomorrow's field trip! I'm excited but scared I'll forget something.

text.zh: 請幫我列一張郊遊要帶的東西清單。
text.en: Please make a checklist of things to bring on a field trip.

text.zh: 請幫我查明天郊遊地點的天氣和交通方式。
text.en: Please check the weather and transport for tomorrow's trip spot.

text.zh: 請推薦幾個適合全班一起去郊遊的地方。
text.en: Please suggest some good places for a class field trip.

explanation.zh: 你需要清單，就請 AI「列清單」。查天氣、推薦地點是別的事；只說怕忘記沒有請它做事。
explanation.en: You need a checklist, so ask for one. Weather or places are other tasks, and saying you're worried asks for nothing.

hint.zh: 你需要的是一張什麼？
hint.en: What do you need AI to make?

scenario.zh: 你要在新班級自我介紹。
scenario.en: You need to introduce yourself to a new class.

question.zh: 哪一句能讓介紹最像你？
question.en: Which one makes the intro sound most like you?

text.zh: 請幫我寫一段很有趣、很特別、大家都會記住的 30 秒自我介紹。
text.en: Please write a fun, unique, memorable 30-second self-introduction.

text.zh: 我四年級，喜歡畫畫和籃球，請幫我寫 30 秒的自我介紹。
text.en: I'm in 4th grade and I like drawing and basketball. Please write a 30-second self-introduction.

text.zh: 請幫我寫 30 秒的自我介紹，要寫出我的興趣和優點。
text.en: Please write a 30-second self-introduction that shows my hobbies and strengths.

text.zh: 我們班導師很嚴格，請幫我寫一段 30 秒的自我介紹。
text.en: My homeroom teacher is strict. Please write a 30-second self-introduction.

explanation.zh: AI 不認識你，要告訴它年級和興趣。形容詞再多、叫它寫「我的興趣」，它也只能亂編；導師嚴格跟介紹無關。
explanation.en: AI doesn't know you, so give your grade and hobbies. Adjectives or 'my hobbies' make it invent things; a strict teacher is irrelevant.

hint.zh: AI 認識你嗎？要先告訴它什麼？
hint.en: Does AI know you? What should you tell it first?

scenario.zh: 你不吃辣，想找午餐建議。
scenario.en: You don't eat spicy food and want lunch ideas.

text.zh: 我不吃辣，請推薦 3 道學校午餐常見的菜。
text.en: I don't eat spicy food. Please suggest 3 common school lunch dishes.

text.zh: 請推薦 3 道好吃、健康、營養均衡的學校午餐常見菜。
text.en: Please suggest 3 tasty, healthy, balanced school lunch dishes.

text.zh: 我最喜歡吃甜點，請推薦 3 道學校午餐常見的菜。
text.en: I love desserts. Please suggest 3 common school lunch dishes.

text.zh: 請推薦 3 道學校午餐常見的菜，要適合我吃的。
text.en: Please suggest 3 common school lunch dishes that suit me.

explanation.zh: 「不吃辣」是 AI 一定要知道的條件。好吃健康、「適合我」，AI 都不知道你不吃辣；喜歡甜點跟午餐無關。
explanation.en: 'No spicy food' is the must-know condition. 'Healthy' or 'suits me' doesn't tell AI that; loving desserts is irrelevant.

hint.zh: 有什麼是 AI 一定要先知道的？
hint.en: What must AI know first?

scenario.zh: 下週五考自然，你每天只有 30 分鐘。
scenario.en: You have a science test next Friday and only 30 minutes a day.

text.zh: 我快要考自然了，請幫我排一個很有效率、一定考高分的讀書計畫。
text.en: My science test is coming. Please make an efficient plan that guarantees a high score.

text.zh: 我的自然成績不太好，請幫我排一個讀書計畫。
text.en: My science grades aren't great. Please make me a study plan.

text.zh: 下週五考自然，請幫我排一個每天讀 3 小時的讀書計畫。
text.en: My science test is next Friday. Please make a plan with 3 hours of study a day.

text.zh: 下週五考自然，我每天有 30 分鐘，請幫我排讀書計畫。
text.en: My science test is next Friday and I have 30 minutes a day. Please make me a study plan.

explanation.zh: 計畫要做得到，AI 需要考試日期和你每天真正有的時間。「一定考高分」不是資訊；每天 3 小時你根本沒有。
explanation.en: A doable plan needs the test date and the time you really have. 'Guaranteed high score' isn't info, and you don't have 3 hours a day.

hint.zh: 計畫要排多久？每天多少時間？
hint.en: How long is the plan? How much time each day?

scenario.zh: 同學小安幫你撿起掉滿地的鉛筆。
scenario.en: Your classmate An helped pick up the pencils you dropped everywhere.

question.zh: 哪一句寫出的卡片最貼心？
question.en: Which one makes the nicest card?

text.zh: 請寫一張很感人、很溫暖、讓小安看了會哭的謝謝卡。
text.en: Please write a touching, warm thank-you card that will make An cry.

text.zh: 小安是我們班的同學，他很高，請寫一張謝謝卡給他。
text.en: An is in my class and he's tall. Please write him a thank-you card.

text.zh: 小安幫我撿起掉滿地的鉛筆，請寫一張謝謝卡給他。
text.en: An helped me pick up the pencils I dropped everywhere. Please write a thank-you card to him.

text.zh: 請寫一張謝謝卡給小安，謝謝他幫了我的忙。
text.en: Please write a thank-you card to An for helping me out.

explanation.zh: 說出小安幫了什麼忙，卡片才寫得具體。「很感人」「幫了我的忙」太模糊；他很高跟謝謝無關。
explanation.en: Say what An did so the card is specific. 'Touching' or 'helping me out' is vague; being tall is irrelevant.

hint.zh: AI 知道你為什麼要謝謝他嗎？
hint.en: Does AI know why you're thanking him?

scenario.zh: 你家住公寓，沒有院子。
scenario.en: You live in an apartment with no yard.

text.zh: 我超級喜歡動物，每一種都好可愛，適合養什麼寵物？
text.en: I love animals so much and they're all cute. What pet should I get?

text.zh: 我家是公寓、沒有院子，適合養什麼寵物？
text.en: I live in an apartment with no yard. What pet would suit me?

text.zh: 我家附近有一間很大的寵物店，適合養什麼寵物？
text.en: There's a big pet shop near my home. What pet should I get?

text.zh: 請推薦最受歡迎、最好照顧的寵物給我。
text.en: Please recommend the most popular, easiest pets.

explanation.zh: 家是公寓、沒院子，才是決定能養什麼的關鍵。喜歡動物、附近有寵物店、最受歡迎，都不會改變答案。
explanation.en: An apartment with no yard is what decides it. Loving animals, a nearby shop or popularity don't change the answer.

hint.zh: 你家有什麼限制？
hint.en: What limits does your home have?

scenario.zh: 生日派對有 6 個 8 歲小朋友，在客廳玩。
scenario.en: Six 8-year-olds are at a birthday party in the living room.

text.zh: 6 個 8 歲小朋友在客廳，請推薦 3 個派對遊戲。
text.en: Six 8-year-olds are in a living room. Please suggest 3 party games.

text.zh: 請推薦 3 個超好玩、大家都會笑的生日派對遊戲。
text.en: Please suggest 3 super fun party games that make everyone laugh.

text.zh: 今天是我的生日，我好開心，請推薦 3 個派對遊戲。
text.en: It's my birthday and I'm so happy! Please suggest 3 party games.

text.zh: 請推薦 3 個可以在大公園裡跑來跑去、玩到流汗的派對遊戲。
text.en: Please suggest 3 party games with lots of running around in a big park until everyone's sweaty.

explanation.zh: 人數、年紀、在客廳，決定遊戲玩不玩得起來。「超好玩」不是資訊；公園跑跳在客廳做不到。
explanation.en: Number, age and a living room decide what works. 'Super fun' isn't info; park running won't work indoors.

hint.zh: 幾個人？幾歲？在哪裡玩？
hint.en: How many? How old? Where?

scenario.zh: 你讀完《小王子》，最喜歡裡面的狐狸。
scenario.en: You finished The Little Prince, and the fox is your favorite.

text.zh: 請幫我列一份《小王子》讀書心得的大綱，要寫得有深度。
text.en: Please outline a deep, insightful book report on The Little Prince.

text.zh: 我很喜歡看書，一個月看 5 本，請幫我列心得的大綱。
text.en: I love reading, 5 books a month. Please help me outline my report.

text.zh: 我讀完《小王子》，請幫我寫一篇完整的心得讓我交。
text.en: I finished The Little Prince. Please write the whole report for me to hand in.

text.zh: 我讀完《小王子》，最喜歡狐狸，請幫我列心得的大綱。
text.en: I finished The Little Prince and my favorite part is the fox. Please help me outline my book report.

explanation.zh: 心得要有你的想法，所以要說你最喜歡哪裡。「有深度」不是你的想法；看幾本書跟這本無關；直接寫好就不是你的心得。
explanation.en: A report needs your own thoughts, so say what you liked. 'Deep' isn't a thought, reading habits are irrelevant, and a finished report isn't yours.

hint.zh: 心得裡最重要的是誰的想法？
hint.en: Whose ideas matter most in a book report?

scenario.zh: 你的科展想比較 3 種土讓綠豆發芽。
scenario.en: Your science project compares 3 kinds of soil for growing mung beans.

text.zh: 我要參加科展，想拿第一名，請幫我想實驗步驟。
text.en: I'm in the science fair and want first place. Please plan my experiment steps.

text.zh: 我很喜歡植物，家裡也有種綠豆，請幫我想實驗步驟。
text.en: I love plants and grow mung beans at home. Please plan my experiment steps.

text.zh: 我要比較 3 種土讓綠豆發芽，請幫我想實驗步驟。
text.en: I'm comparing 3 kinds of soil for growing mung beans. Please help me plan the experiment steps.

text.zh: 請幫我想一個讓綠豆長得最快、最高的實驗，步驟越多越好。
text.en: Please plan an experiment to make mung beans grow fastest and tallest, with as many steps as possible.

explanation.zh: AI 要知道你的題目（比較 3 種土）才能設計步驟。想拿第一、家裡有種綠豆都不是題目；步驟越多越好也不是好條件。
explanation.en: AI needs your topic (comparing 3 soils) to plan steps. Wanting first place or growing beans isn't a topic, and 'more steps' isn't a good condition.

hint.zh: 你的科展題目，AI 知道嗎？
hint.en: Does AI know your topic?

scenario.zh: 阿嬤看不懂太難的字。
scenario.en: Grandma can't read hard words.

text.zh: 請用有禮貌、很正式的敬語寫一封給阿嬤的信。
text.en: Please write Grandma a very formal, polite letter.

text.zh: 請用有趣的網路用語和表情符號寫信給阿嬤。
text.en: Please write Grandma a letter with fun internet slang and emojis.

text.zh: 請用簡單、溫暖的話寫一封給阿嬤的信。
text.en: Please write a letter to Grandma in simple, warm words.

text.zh: 請用優美的成語和詩句寫一封給阿嬤的信。
text.en: Please write Grandma a letter full of fancy idioms and poetry.

explanation.zh: 阿嬤看不懂難字，所以要「簡單、溫暖」。正式敬語太生疏、網路用語她看不懂、成語詩句太難。
explanation.en: Grandma can't read hard words, so 'simple and warm'. Formal is distant, slang is confusing, idioms are too hard.

hint.zh: 阿嬤喜歡什麼樣的說話方式？
hint.en: How does Grandma like people to talk?

scenario.zh: 你想把這一課的重點整理好複習。
scenario.en: You want to sum up this lesson for review.

text.zh: 請把這一課的重點寫成一段完整、通順的文章。
text.en: Please turn this lesson into one smooth, complete paragraph.

text.zh: 請把這一課的重點整理成 5 點條列。
text.en: Please sum up this lesson in 5 bullet points.

text.zh: 請把這一課的每一句話都整理出來，一句都不漏。
text.en: Please list every sentence of this lesson without missing any.

text.zh: 請把這一課改寫成一個有趣的小故事。
text.en: Please rewrite this lesson as a fun short story.

explanation.zh: 複習要一眼看到重點，條列最方便。整段文章不好找重點；每句都抄等於沒整理；小故事好看但不好複習。
explanation.en: Review needs key points at a glance, so bullets. A paragraph hides them, copying everything isn't summarizing, and a story is hard to review.

hint.zh: 什麼樣子最好複習？
hint.en: What's easiest to review?

scenario.zh: 班會上要宣布掃地輪值。
scenario.en: You'll announce cleaning duties at the class meeting.

text.zh: 請把掃地輪值做成表格：星期、名字、掃地區域。
text.en: Please make the cleaning duties into a table: day, name, area.

text.zh: 請把掃地輪值寫成一段話，我唸給全班聽就好。
text.en: Please write the cleaning duties as a paragraph I can read aloud.

text.zh: 請把掃地輪值做成表格，做得越漂亮越好。
text.en: Please make the cleaning duties into a table, as pretty as possible.

text.zh: 請把掃地輪值依照同學座號，一個一個列出來。
text.en: Please list the cleaning duties by student number, one by one.

explanation.zh: 表格一目了然，還要說清楚有哪幾欄。唸一段話記不住；「越漂亮越好」沒說要放什麼；只列名字看不出哪天掃哪裡。
explanation.en: A table is clear, and naming columns matters. A paragraph is forgettable, 'pretty' says nothing about content, and names alone don't show day or area.

hint.zh: 大家最想一眼看到什麼？
hint.en: What does everyone want to see quickly?

scenario.zh: 你要向一年級學弟妹解釋颱風。
scenario.en: You're explaining typhoons to 1st graders.

text.zh: 請用正確的科學名詞，完整解釋颱風是怎麼形成的。
text.en: Explain in correct scientific terms exactly how typhoons form.

text.zh: 請用一年級聽得懂的話，寫一篇 1000 字的颱風介紹。
text.en: Write a 1,000-word typhoon introduction a 1st grader can understand.

text.zh: 請把颱風的資料整理成表格：風速、雨量、氣壓。
text.en: Make a table of typhoon data: wind speed, rainfall and pressure.

text.zh: 請用一年級聽得懂的話，3 句解釋颱風。
text.en: Explain typhoons in 3 sentences a 1st grader can understand.

explanation.zh: 一年級需要簡單又短的說明。科學名詞太難；1000 字太長聽不完；數據表格他們看不懂。
explanation.en: 1st graders need short and simple. Scientific terms are too hard, 1,000 words is too long, and data tables are confusing.

hint.zh: 聽的人幾年級？
hint.en: What grade are the listeners?

scenario.zh: 同學比賽前很緊張。
scenario.en: Your classmate is nervous before a contest.

text.zh: 請用冷靜、分析的語氣，告訴他比賽輸贏的機率。
text.en: In a calm, analytical tone, tell them their odds of winning.

text.zh: 請用嚴格教練的語氣寫一句話，叫他絕對不准失誤。
text.en: In a strict coach's tone, write one line telling them not to mess up.

text.zh: 請用活潑、鼓勵的語氣寫一句加油的話。
text.en: Please write one cheerful, encouraging line to wish them luck.

text.zh: 請用活潑的語氣寫一篇 500 字的比賽注意事項。
text.en: In a cheerful tone, write a 500-word list of contest rules.

explanation.zh: 緊張的人需要被鼓勵，而且一句就夠。分析機率、嚴格要求會更緊張；500 字的注意事項太長。
explanation.en: A nervous friend needs one encouraging line. Odds or strict orders add pressure, and 500 words of rules is too much.

hint.zh: 緊張的人想聽到什麼語氣？
hint.en: What tone helps a nervous friend?

scenario.zh: 你想把 10 個單字做成好背的樣子。
scenario.en: You want to turn 10 words into something easy to memorize.

text.zh: 請把 10 個單字寫成一篇用到全部單字的短文。
text.en: Please write a short story that uses all 10 words.

text.zh: 請做成單字小卡：正面英文，背面中文和一個例句。
text.en: Please make word cards: English on the front, Chinese and an example sentence on the back.

text.zh: 請把 10 個單字依照字母順序排成一長串。
text.en: Please put the 10 words in one long line in ABC order.

text.zh: 請做成單字小卡，每張寫滿這個字所有的意思。
text.en: Please make word cards, each filled with every meaning of the word.

explanation.zh: 小卡一面一個重點最好背。短文和一長串不好背；每張寫滿所有意思反而記不住。
explanation.en: Cards with one point per side are easiest. A story or a long line is hard to memorize, and every meaning is too much.

hint.zh: 背單字最好用什麼樣子？
hint.en: What's the best way to memorize words?

scenario.zh: 海報上的標語要短，大家才看得到。
scenario.en: Poster slogans must be short so everyone can see them.

text.zh: 請給我 3 句 8 個字以內的標語。
text.en: Please give me 3 slogans of 8 words or fewer.

text.zh: 請給我 3 句寫清楚活動時間、地點和內容的標語。
text.en: Please give me 3 slogans that explain the event's time, place and content.

text.zh: 請給我 3 句用很多形容詞、很華麗的標語。
text.en: Please give me 3 fancy slogans full of adjectives.

text.zh: 請給我 30 句標語，越多越好讓我慢慢挑。
text.en: Please give me 30 slogans. The more the better.

explanation.zh: 海報標語要短，遠遠就看得到。寫滿時間地點太長；華麗形容詞難記；30 句太多挑不完。
explanation.en: Poster slogans must be short to read from afar. Time and place make them long, adjectives are hard to remember, and 30 is too many.

hint.zh: 標語要多長？
hint.en: How long should a slogan be?

scenario.zh: 你想把週末要做的事排好。
scenario.en: You want to organize your weekend.

text.zh: 請把我的週末計畫寫成一篇有開頭和結尾的日記。
text.en: Please write my weekend plan as a diary with a beginning and end.

text.zh: 請把週末計畫排成時間表，越詳細越好，每 5 分鐘一格。
text.en: Please make my weekend a schedule, as detailed as possible, every 5 minutes.

text.zh: 請把我週末想做的事，照喜歡的程度排順序。
text.en: Please rank what I want to do this weekend by how much I like it.

text.zh: 請把我的週末計畫排成時間表：時間｜要做的事。
text.en: Please make my weekend plan into a schedule: time | activity.

explanation.zh: 時間表一眼就知道幾點做什麼。日記不好照著做；每 5 分鐘一格太細；只排喜好沒有時間。
explanation.en: A schedule shows what and when. A diary is hard to follow, 5-minute slots are too fine, and a ranking has no times.

hint.zh: 哪個樣子最容易照著做？
hint.en: Which format is easiest to follow?

scenario.zh: 你要向全班報告海龜。
scenario.en: You'll give a report on sea turtles to your class.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一份海龜報告，內容要多、圖片要漂亮。
text.en: Please write a sea turtle report with lots of content and pretty pictures.

text.zh: 請幫我寫海龜報告，目標是讓老師覺得我很用功。
text.en: Please write a sea turtle report. The goal is to make the teacher think I work hard.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一份海龜報告，把海龜的種類全部介紹一遍。
text.en: Please write a sea turtle report introducing every kind of sea turtle.

text.zh: 請幫我寫海龜報告，目標是讓同學知道怎麼保護海龜。
text.en: Please help me write a sea turtle report. The goal is for classmates to learn how to protect sea turtles.

explanation.zh: 目標是讓同學學會保護海龜，報告就有重點。內容多、介紹全部種類沒有方向；讓老師覺得你用功不是報告要達成的事。
explanation.en: The goal (classmates learn to protect turtles) gives focus. Lots of content or every species has no direction; impressing the teacher isn't the report's purpose.

hint.zh: 報告完，你希望同學學到什麼？
hint.en: What should classmates learn by the end?

scenario.zh: 你要競選班長。
scenario.en: You're running for class leader.

text.zh: 請幫我寫班長演講，要用很多成語，聽起來很厲害。
text.en: Please write my class leader speech with lots of fancy words so I sound smart.

text.zh: 請幫我寫班長演講，目標是講得比其他候選人都久。
text.en: Please write my class leader speech. The goal is to talk longer than the others.

text.zh: 請幫我寫班長演講，目標是讓同學覺得我會認真做事。
text.en: Please write my class leader speech. The goal is to show classmates I'll work hard.

text.zh: 請幫我寫班長演講，把我所有的優點和得過的獎狀都列出來。
text.en: Please write my class leader speech listing all my good points and every award I've won.

explanation.zh: 演講要讓同學相信你會認真做事，才會投你。成語多、講得久都不是目的；列出所有優點沒有重點。
explanation.en: The speech should convince classmates you'll work hard. Fancy words or talking longest aren't goals, and listing every strength has no focus.

hint.zh: 你希望同學聽完怎麼想？
hint.en: How do you want classmates to feel afterward?

scenario.zh: 你想讓自己的作文變好，但還是你寫的。
scenario.en: You want a better essay that's still yours.

text.zh: 請幫我把作文改成可以參加比賽得獎的程度，怎麼改都可以。
text.en: Please make my essay good enough to win a writing contest. Change anything you want.

text.zh: 請幫我改作文，讓句子更通順，但不要改掉我的想法。
text.en: Please improve my essay so the sentences flow better, but keep my ideas.

text.zh: 請幫我改作文，把所有句子都換成更高級的詞。
text.en: Please improve my essay by replacing every sentence with fancier words.

text.zh: 請幫我改作文，改完告訴我總共改了幾個地方。
text.en: Please fix my essay and tell me how many places you changed.

explanation.zh: 說清楚要改到什麼程度：句子通順、想法保留。「怎麼改都可以」「全換高級詞」會變成 AI 的作文；只要數字沒說要改好什麼。
explanation.en: Say how much to change: smoother sentences, same ideas. 'Change anything' or fancy words make it AI's essay; a count doesn't say what to improve.

hint.zh: 你要 AI 改一點，還是全部重寫？
hint.en: A small fix or a full rewrite?

scenario.zh: 你想檢查自己懂不懂乘法。
scenario.en: You want to check if you understand multiplication.

text.zh: 請出 5 題乘法讓我練習，我寫完再給答案。
text.en: Give me 5 multiplication problems to practice, and show the answers after I finish.

text.zh: 請出 5 題乘法，題目和答案一起給我，方便我對。
text.en: Give me 5 multiplication problems with the answers right next to them.

text.zh: 請出 5 題最難的乘法題給我，越難越好。
text.en: Give me the 5 hardest multiplication problems possible.

text.zh: 請把九九乘法表整理成表格，讓我多看幾遍。
text.en: Please make the times tables into a chart so I can read it again.

explanation.zh: 目標是檢查自己懂不懂，所以先寫再看答案。答案一起給就沒辦法檢查；最難的題不一定測得出；看表格是背，不是檢查。
explanation.en: The goal is checking yourself, so answer first, then see answers. Answers next to questions ruin the check; hardest isn't a fair test; a chart is memorizing, not checking.

hint.zh: 先看答案，還能檢查自己嗎？
hint.en: Can you check yourself if you see the answers first?

scenario.zh: 你想說服爸媽週末帶你去動物園。
scenario.en: You want to convince your parents to go to the zoo this weekend.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一篇介紹動物園有多好玩的文章，寫得越長越好。
text.en: Please write an article about how much fun the zoo is. Make it as long as possible.

text.zh: 請幫我查這個週末動物園的開放時間和票價。
text.en: Please look up the zoo's hours and ticket prices this weekend.

text.zh: 請幫我想 3 個理由，說明我為什麼最喜歡動物。
text.en: Please think of 3 reasons why animals are my favorite.

text.zh: 請幫我想 3 個理由，讓爸媽答應週末去動物園。
text.en: Help me think of 3 reasons so my parents agree to go to the zoo this weekend.

explanation.zh: 目標是讓爸媽答應，理由要能說服他們。長文章、查票價、說你喜歡動物，都沒有直接回答爸媽「為什麼要去」。
explanation.en: The goal is getting a yes, so reasons must persuade parents. A long article, ticket info or why you love animals doesn't answer 'why go'.

hint.zh: 你想要的結果是什麼？
hint.en: What result do you want?

scenario.zh: 你們 4 個人要一起做報告。
scenario.en: Four of you are doing a report together.

text.zh: 我們 4 人要做報告，請幫忙分工，讓最厲害的人做最多。
text.en: Four of us are doing a report. Split the work so the best student does most.

text.zh: 我們 4 人要做報告，請直接幫我們把報告寫好。
text.en: Four of us are doing a report. Please just write it for us.

text.zh: 我們 4 人要做報告，請幫忙分工，讓每個人都有事做。
text.en: Four of us are doing a report. Please split the work so everyone has a job.

text.zh: 我們 4 人要做報告，請列出報告需要的所有資料。
text.en: Four of us are doing a report. Please list all the materials we need.

explanation.zh: 目標是每個人都有事做，AI 才會想到公平分工。讓最厲害的做最多不公平；直接寫好大家沒學到；列資料沒有分工。
explanation.en: The goal 'everyone has a job' leads to fair splitting. Giving the best student most is unfair, writing it teaches nothing, and a list isn't a split.

hint.zh: 分工要達成什麼？
hint.en: What should the split achieve?

scenario.zh: 你要參加「未來城市」畫畫比賽。
scenario.en: You're entering a 'Future City' drawing contest.

text.zh: 我要畫「未來城市」參加比賽，請直接幫我畫一張得獎作品。
text.en: I'm drawing a 'Future City' for a contest. Please draw a winning picture for me.

text.zh: 我要畫「未來城市」參加比賽，請給我 3 個有創意、別人不容易想到的點子。
text.en: I'm drawing a 'Future City' for a contest. Please give me 3 creative ideas others won't think of.

text.zh: 我要畫「未來城市」參加比賽，請介紹未來城市的歷史。
text.en: I'm drawing a 'Future City' for a contest. Tell me the history of future cities.

text.zh: 我要畫「未來城市」參加比賽，請告訴我大家最常畫、最多人想得到的點子有哪些。
text.en: I'm drawing a 'Future City' for a contest. Tell me which ideas are the most common ones people draw.

explanation.zh: 比賽要有創意，所以要「別人不容易想到」的點子。直接畫好就不是你的作品；歷史用不上；最多人畫的點子不特別。
explanation.en: A contest needs originality, so ask for uncommon ideas. A finished drawing isn't yours, history won't help, and popular ideas aren't special.

hint.zh: 你要 AI 幫你畫，還是幫你想？
hint.en: Do you want AI to draw for you or think with you?

scenario.zh: 你要上台講故事，只有 1 分鐘。
scenario.en: You'll tell a story on stage and only have 1 minute.

text.zh: 請寫一個能在 1 分鐘內講完的故事。
text.en: Please write a story I can tell in under 1 minute.

text.zh: 請寫一個很精彩、有很多角色和轉折的故事。
text.en: Please write an exciting story with lots of characters and twists.

text.zh: 請寫一個故事，要有開頭、中間和結尾。
text.en: Please write a story with a beginning, middle and end.

text.zh: 請寫一個故事，寫完後幫我算有幾個字。
text.en: Please write a story and count the words when you're done.

explanation.zh: 上台只有 1 分鐘，要先說好「怎樣才算完成」。很多角色和轉折會太長；有頭有尾每個故事都有；算字數沒有限制長度。
explanation.en: With 1 minute on stage, say what 'done' means. Many characters and twists run long, every story has a start and end, and counting words doesn't limit length.

hint.zh: 上台時間有多長？
hint.en: How much time do you have on stage?

scenario.zh: 你們小隊要取一個隊名。
scenario.en: Your team needs a name.

text.zh: 請幫我們想 5 個隊名，要像「閃電小隊」一樣短又有力。
text.en: Please give us 5 team names, short and strong like 'Lightning Squad'.

text.zh: 請幫我們想 5 個隊名，要很酷、很特別、很好聽。
text.en: Please give us 5 team names that are cool, special and sound great.

text.zh: 請幫我們想 5 個隊名，越長越好，要有很多意思。
text.en: Please give us 5 team names, as long as possible with lots of meaning.

text.zh: 請幫我們想 5 個隊名，要跟其他隊都不一樣。
text.en: Please give us 5 team names that are different from every other team.

explanation.zh: 給一個例子，AI 就知道你要的感覺。「很酷很特別」每個人想的不一樣；越長越難喊；AI 不知道別隊叫什麼。
explanation.en: An example shows the feeling you want. 'Cool and special' means different things to everyone, long names are hard to shout, and AI doesn't know other teams' names.

hint.zh: 可以給 AI 一個喜歡的例子嗎？
hint.en: Can you give AI an example you like?

scenario.zh: 老師說只能用課文回答問題。
scenario.en: Your teacher says answers must come only from the lesson text.

text.zh: 請根據課文回答，如果課文寫得不夠清楚，就上網多找一些資料補充。
text.en: Answer from the text, and if it's not clear enough, look online for more info to add.

text.zh: 請根據課文回答，答得越詳細越好，可以自己延伸。
text.en: Answer from the text in as much detail as possible. Feel free to add more.

text.zh: 請盡量回答，不確定的地方用你知道的知識補上。
text.en: Answer as best you can, and fill gaps with what you know.

text.zh: 請只根據我貼上的課文回答，課文沒寫的就說「不知道」。
text.en: Answer only from the text I pasted. If it's not in the text, say 'I don't know.'

explanation.zh: 老師規定只能用課文，就要限定來源，並說好沒寫的怎麼辦。上網補充、自己延伸、用 AI 的知識補，都會超出課文。
explanation.en: Only the text is allowed, so limit the source and say what to do if it's missing. Searching online, adding more or filling gaps all go beyond the text.

hint.zh: 老師規定只能用什麼？
hint.en: Where must answers come from?

scenario.zh: 你要用「因為……所以……」造句。
scenario.en: You need to make sentences with 'because'.

text.zh: 請用「因為……所以……」造 3 個又長又難的句子。
text.en: Make 3 long, difficult sentences using 'because'.

text.zh: 請用「因為……所以……」造 3 個句子，越特別、越有創意、越讓人驚訝越好。
text.en: Make 3 sentences using 'because'. The more unusual, creative and surprising the better.

text.zh: 請用「因為……所以……」造 3 個句子，例如：因為下雨，所以我帶傘。
text.en: Make 3 sentences using 'because'. Example: I took an umbrella because it rained.

text.zh: 請解釋「因為……所以……」的意思和用法。
text.en: Please explain what 'because' means and how to use it.

explanation.zh: 給例句，AI 造出來的句子就會跟你要的一樣簡單清楚。又長又難、越特別越好沒有標準；解釋用法不是造句。
explanation.en: An example sentence gets exactly the kind you need. 'Long and hard' or 'unusual' has no standard; explaining usage isn't making sentences.

hint.zh: 有沒有例句可以給 AI 參考？
hint.en: Is there an example you can give AI?

scenario.zh: 弟弟怕可怕的故事。
scenario.en: Your little brother is afraid of scary stories.

text.zh: 請寫一個冒險故事，要有很多刺激、驚險的情節。
text.en: Please write an adventure story full of thrilling, dangerous moments.

text.zh: 請寫一個冒險故事，不要有可怕或打鬥的情節。
text.en: Please write an adventure story with nothing scary and no fighting.

text.zh: 請寫一個冒險故事，主角要很勇敢、很厲害。
text.en: Please write an adventure story with a brave, powerful hero.

text.zh: 請寫一個冒險故事，最後壞人要被打敗。
text.en: Please write an adventure story where the villain gets defeated.

explanation.zh: 說出「不要什麼」，AI 才會避開弟弟怕的內容。刺激驚險、打敗壞人都可能出現可怕或打鬥；主角勇敢沒有排除任何東西。
explanation.en: Saying what to avoid keeps out what your brother fears. Danger or defeating a villain may bring fights, and a brave hero rules nothing out.

hint.zh: 有什麼是一定不能出現的？
hint.en: What must not appear?

scenario.zh: 你在兩本書之間猶豫。
scenario.en: You can't decide between two books.

text.zh: 請用「好不好讀、有沒有圖、多長」比較這兩本書。
text.en: Compare these two books by: easy to read, pictures, and length.

text.zh: 請比較這兩本書，告訴我哪一本比較好。
text.en: Please compare these two books and tell me which is better.

text.zh: 請比較這兩本書，把兩本的內容都完整講一遍。
text.en: Please compare these two books by retelling both stories in full.

text.zh: 請比較這兩本書，看哪一本得過比較多獎。
text.en: Please compare these two books by which won more awards.

explanation.zh: 用你在乎的標準比較，結果才對你有用。「哪本比較好」沒有標準；完整講內容太長；得獎多不一定適合你。
explanation.en: Compare by what you care about. 'Which is better' has no criteria, retelling is too long, and awards don't mean it suits you.

hint.zh: 你用什麼標準選書？
hint.en: How do you choose books?

scenario.zh: 老師規定日記要照格式寫。
scenario.en: Your teacher wants diaries in a set format.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一篇日記，格式你自己決定就好。
text.en: Please write a diary entry in whatever format you like.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一篇日記，要跟作家寫的一樣好。
text.en: Please write a diary entry as good as a real author's.

text.zh: 請幫我寫一篇日記，把今天每一件事都寫進去。
text.en: Please write a diary entry with everything that happened today.

text.zh: 請照這個格式寫：日期、天氣、今天最開心的事。
text.en: Please use this format: date, weather, best moment of the day.

explanation.zh: 把老師的格式給 AI，寫出來才符合規定。自己決定格式、像作家一樣都不是老師的規定；每件事都寫太長。
explanation.en: Give AI the teacher's format so it follows the rules. 'Any format' or 'like an author' isn't the rule, and everything is too long.

hint.zh: 老師的格式是什麼？
hint.en: What is the teacher's format?

scenario.zh: 介紹要貼在小卡上，只能寫 50 字。
scenario.en: The intro goes on a small card with room for only 50 words.

text.zh: 請介紹台灣黑熊，重點要清楚、寫得好一點。
text.en: Introduce the Formosan black bear clearly and nicely.

text.zh: 請盡量詳細地介紹台灣黑熊，我再自己刪短。
text.en: Introduce the Formosan black bear in full detail, and I'll cut it down.

text.zh: 請用 50 字以內介紹台灣黑熊。
text.en: Introduce the Formosan black bear in 50 words or fewer.

text.zh: 請介紹台灣黑熊，要寫到牠的所有特徵。
text.en: Introduce the Formosan black bear, covering all its features.

explanation.zh: 小卡只放得下 50 字，直接限制字數最準。「寫好一點」沒有長度；寫長再刪很費工；所有特徵一定放不下。
explanation.en: The card fits 50 words, so set the limit. 'Nicely' has no length, cutting it yourself is extra work, and every feature won't fit.

hint.zh: 小卡能寫多少字？
hint.en: How much fits on the card?

scenario.zh: 你想出謎語給同學猜。
scenario.en: You want riddles for your classmates.

text.zh: 請出 3 個水果謎語，要很難，讓同學都猜不到。
text.en: Give me 3 fruit riddles so hard nobody can guess them.

text.zh: 請出 3 個水果謎語，例如：紅紅圓圓，咬一口甜甜（蘋果）。
text.en: Give me 3 fruit riddles. Example: Red and round, sweet when you bite (apple).

text.zh: 請出 3 個水果謎語，要很有趣、很好笑。
text.en: Give me 3 fruit riddles that are really funny.

text.zh: 請出 3 個謎語給我，什麼主題都可以。
text.en: Give me 3 riddles about anything.

explanation.zh: 示範一個，AI 就知道謎語要多難、長什麼樣子。「很難」「很好笑」沒有標準；什麼主題都可以就不是水果謎語。
explanation.en: One example shows how hard and what shape. 'Hard' or 'funny' has no standard, and 'anything' isn't fruit riddles.

hint.zh: 可以先示範一個給 AI 看嗎？
hint.en: Can you show AI one first?

scenario.zh: 你想和家人一起做餅乾。
scenario.en: You want to bake cookies with your family.

text.zh: 請告訴我做餅乾的方法，全部寫在一段話裡就好。
text.en: Please tell me how to make cookies all in one paragraph.

text.zh: 請把做餅乾的方法分成步驟，一步寫一行。
text.en: Please break the cookie recipe into steps, one per line.

text.zh: 請列出做餅乾需要的所有材料和份量。
text.en: Please list all the ingredients and amounts for cookies.

text.zh: 請告訴我做餅乾最重要的一個祕訣。
text.en: Please tell me the single most important cookie tip.

explanation.zh: 分步驟、一步一行，照著做才不會亂。一段話容易漏步驟；只有材料不知道怎麼做；一個祕訣不夠。
explanation.en: Steps, one per line, are easy to follow. A paragraph hides steps, ingredients alone don't say how, and one tip isn't enough.

hint.zh: 怎樣最容易跟著做？
hint.en: What's easiest to follow?

scenario.zh: 你想學摺紙鶴。
scenario.en: You want to learn to fold a paper crane.

text.zh: 請一步一步教我摺紙鶴，每一步等我說「好」再繼續。
text.en: Teach me to fold a paper crane step by step. Wait until I say 'OK' before each next step.

text.zh: 請把摺紙鶴的全部步驟一次列出來，我自己看。
text.en: Please list all the paper crane steps at once and I'll read them.

text.zh: 請告訴我摺紙鶴要用多大、什麼顏色的紙。
text.en: Please tell me what size and color paper to use for a crane.

text.zh: 請告訴我紙鶴代表什麼意思、有什麼故事。
text.en: Please tell me what paper cranes mean and their story.

explanation.zh: 一步一步來，還能確認你跟上了，不會摺到一半卡住。一次列完容易跟丟；紙的大小顏色、紙鶴故事都沒教怎麼摺。
explanation.en: Step by step lets you check you're keeping up. All at once is easy to lose, and paper size or the story doesn't teach folding.

hint.zh: 一次講完，你記得住嗎？
hint.en: Could you remember everything at once?

scenario.zh: 你卡在一題數學應用題。
scenario.en: You're stuck on a math word problem.

question.en: Which one helps you learn it?

text.zh: 請直接給我這一題的答案，我再自己慢慢想想看是怎麼算出來的。
text.en: Just give me the answer to this one, and I'll slowly figure out how it was worked out.

text.zh: 請告訴我這一題是在考哪一個單元。
text.en: Please tell me which unit this problem is from.

text.zh: 請給我一題差不多的題目，我先練習看看。
